**The SC Legislature passed a budget. Communities lost the most with no earmarks.**
South Carolina state government has been operating under a continuing resolution since July 1 because the legislature was unable to finalize a spending plan before the start of the new fiscal year.
Budget writers set aside $377.7 million for lawmaker projects in a separate piece of legislation. They gave themselves a Sept. 30 deadline to allocate the money, but lawmakers would have had to come back in the fall to approve a supplemental spending bill, which risks the possibility of negative headlines on certain projects less than two months before the November election.
Budget negotiators had agreed to have a joint committee decide how much money each earmark received. That went out the window as budget writers tried to resolve earmark funding before Tuesday’s session, and communities are the ones who will lose the most.[ Read more here.](https://us.list-manage.com/16ZLXxGO9x7?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)

name: Teresa Leger Fernandez
subject: An official Twitter account of the U.S. government attacked me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Asking if you can invest in our fight with a contribution.

| | |
---
_Source NM:_
**New Mexico U.S. Rep. Leger Fernández denounces ICE arrest in Santa Fe healthcare clinic parking lot**
**We must not look away or step aside while ICE terrorizes our communities, friend.**
This week, we learned that ICE agents had arrested and detained a man outside a health center in Santa Fe. The man was taking his young daughter to the clinic to receive medical care — instead, she was left _behind_ when ICE took her father.

All along, we’ve seen that the Trump Administration’s immigration policies are based on corruption and cruelty. Their actions are designed to instill fear in our communities and prevent us from standing up to them.

That’s why I’m reaching out personally today, friend. As your U.S. Representative, and as your next Governor, Deb Haaland and I will defend our communities and push back against the Trump Administration’s attacks. **We will do everything we can to protect New Mexicans from these abuses, but we can’t do it alone._[Can you split a donation of $5 between our campaigns today?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16260?refcode=jtk1255-bu-nd&t=1&akid=11946%2E400544%2ECToZFC)_**
| | [SPLIT A DONATION](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16260?refcode=jtk1255-bu-nd&t=2&akid=11946%2E400544%2ECToZFC)
---
After learning about the father who was taken, I went to ICE’s detention facility in Torrance County to ask questions about this recent detention and inspect its conditions. Their response? They chose to try to intimidate me on Twitter. An official Twitter account of the U.S. government _attacked_ me directly for holding them accountable to treating people with respect and basic sanitation requirements, it is my legal right and duty to do so.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16260?refcode=jtk1255-bu-nd&t=3&akid=11946%2E400544%2ECToZFC)
I’m not backing down, and neither is my former colleague and friend Deb Haaland, our next Governor of New Mexico. She spoke up in response, standing with me and our communities against these attacks. Deb shares my commitment to defending our people and holding the Trump Administration accountable, and I know we’ll continue this fight together.
**_[Friend, I’ll continue performing my constitutional and legal duty of conducting congressional oversight of ICE facilities no matter what the Trump Administration says about me. And as our next Governor, Deb Haaland will use every power at her disposal to protect our state from the Trump Administration. I am asking you to split a $20 donation to our campaigns right now to help.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16260?refcode=jtk1255-bu-nd&t=4&akid=11946%2E400544%2ECToZFC)_**
| | [SPLIT A DONATION](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16260?refcode=jtk1255-bu-nd&t=5&akid=11946%2E400544%2ECToZFC)
---
In solidarity,

Teresa

| Voters are sick of the same old mess. And the election results across the country are proving it.
On Tuesday alone, not one, not two, but THREE Trump-endorsed candidates lost their primaries. In races that were supposed to be safe. In places MAGA thought they had locked up.
Sound familiar? It's just like my race for Senate here in Louisiana. Nobody took us seriously, but now? We're knocking right on the door of history.
And if that wasn't proof enough:
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014kJvSDkrQrICpO3c2IicRRqkgsvqCh3VwigtzJ4C93Kx6xbxTDaG0ezSovWTc_3pGNKJ3LlXfTTSTAwfziuecuxsbI-HGJLn1rJtHMhxVbvkXb6HHKsP45btUYOZtAsX1RE5LWpSZtDzHOVcNzynhYdUPTPbUXzUNW_uRW8drnQt1A2mbrkh4sbXJxX-FMQiQstKPNt3yzJirxj4rMneUmRN6hN6fdQ9&c=JWE6RqRXaTKDbDilQtXNGApwmluvbtkCzLsTc_h_jqI75ISxdqfuYA==&ch=gD95iJ1iV7Sw6AIYP2gu4vLr_MU7AxhF5LJiDBI0ZvcW7cFhyeL_MA==)
---
Trump's approval rating in Louisiana is NEGATIVE FIVE.
Yes. You read that right. The man who won this state by 20 points is now underwater right here in the Deep South.
And why wouldn't he be? Tariffs have been brutal for Louisiana farmers and their exports. The cost of living has skyrocketed. We're in yet another pointless, costly war with Iran that nobody voted for. And the Trump family corruption runs so deep it's almost hard to fathom -- from Epstein connections to stock trading schemes to UFC fights on the White House lawn.
Voters are sick of the chaos, double talk, and confusion. And they're sick of his minions, like my opponent, Julia Letlow.
Here's what I know after months on this campaign trail: No state is a red state forever. We flip them blue by picking our spots, staying strong, and running the right candidate with the right message at exactly the right moment.
That's what we're doing right here in Louisiana.

body:
Trump will stop at nothing to get his hands on your sensitive data. And now he has a new scheme, a new puppet, and a court willing to grant his every wish.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cblb4vinv61THzNEt67beV3pZnSDCgdxJuRvnVWborZs-RmIHrto0AetoWQ_p2kLrsm1ptUncLkIC88rZE-mqUxUI8wylPhYNl3v7YM8TBzP4NnLe9Ni1nr220OOiCqU_exhinsonGdgskcPMNBOwGywIJAEQwbWePshO4KeOo3BX8dVMLnnfBLfU_z7xWesrYzKTvfc8jB7_NsU3JoXiWwLRFsZhkcqoSbmHafO7rU=&c=XckpzLJqtrvGOgTE21agbqPl-nVCa3TTPsKBY2Gk1PV96tyTOBZunw==&ch=7Tn8idW-CJeHlMAJ4URtYErxkSZt0jYr_clM3AaPvC2TVwTn6rONMw==)
---
|
Peter,
Todd Blanche has been Attorney General for the Trump administration for a little over a week, and it's clear right off the bat he's not interested in fighting crime.
Rather, Blanche is running errands for Trump's election rigging wish list. And near the top of that list sits one of his most prized targets: your voter data. Voter data that includes sensitive information such as your name, address, and party registration.
After a string of lower level court losses, Blanche now says the Department of Justice may take its case to the MAGA-occupied Supreme Court, a last ditch attempt to force blue states to turn over your sensitive voting data.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cblb4vinv61THzNEt67beV3pZnSDCgdxJuRvnVWborZs-RmIHrto0AetoWQ_p2kLrsm1ptUncLkIC88rZE-mqUxUI8wylPhYNl3v7YM8TBzP4NnLe9Ni1nr220OOiCqU_exhinsonGdgskcPMNBOwGywIJAEQwbWePshO4KeOo3BX8dVMLnnfBLfU_z7xWesrYzKTvfc8jB7_NsU3JoXiejpKB8eHrkpVNhkLNOOoTE=&c=XckpzLJqtrvGOgTE21agbqPl-nVCa3TTPsKBY2Gk1PV96tyTOBZunw==&ch=7Tn8idW-CJeHlMAJ4URtYErxkSZt0jYr_clM3AaPvC2TVwTn6rONMw==)
---
Trump will stop at nothing to get his hands on your sensitive data. And now he has a new scheme, a new puppet, and a court willing to grant his every wish.
If you have been following Defend Our Courts, you know we have been deeply critical of the Supreme Court. They overturned Roe. They gutted the Voting Rights Act. They handed Trump criminal immunity. This court has been fully exposed as a puppet of Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to torch a half-century of precedent to tilt elections their way.
We have also been sounding the alarm on Trump's attempts to seize your voter data, including having the USPS threaten to withhold mail-in ballots, and more recently, threatening to jail election officials who don't hand them your voting data.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cblb4vinv61THzNEt67beV3pZnSDCgdxJuRvnVWborZs-RmIHrto0AetoWQ_p2kLrsm1ptUncLkIC88rZE-mqUxUI8wylPhYNl3v7YM8TBzP4NnLe9Ni1nr220OOiCqU_exhinsonGdgskcPMNBOwGywIJAEQwbWePshO4KeOo3BX8dVMLnnfBLfU_z7xWesrYzKTvfc8jB7_NsU3JoXiSruowhjN2StKIe1Pb-OXw8=&c=XckpzLJqtrvGOgTE21agbqPl-nVCa3TTPsKBY2Gk1PV96tyTOBZunw==&ch=7Tn8idW-CJeHlMAJ4URtYErxkSZt0jYr_clM3AaPvC2TVwTn6rONMw==)
---

**Whatever happened to TV Infomercials?** If you ever found yourself wide awake at 2 a.m., mesmerized by a man slicing tomatoes paper-thin while shouting "_But wait, there's more!_ " then you already know about the golden age of TV infomercials. And odds are, [the man doing the slicing was Ron Popeil](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMV2QGUMwhYtIN6luttliSzTYY_DKhshMjPL2q-wrbHuO9BX_1328Y4hhnT8wkWG_jSsdeyRmymPCGR9oGfNMvKfgmHLa94QjSDifpD6BGtFyKDS2WDnjiYBURabpdd_2Qzd01WKcJ9tMU-d6rydlJ-lJIigYet1MrqMqmLcnNahGyrNSdQsA3rfaanDkhkG0klzgLdffW1h5IR9fW6Fc2y1V0SzMj12oi4CbgNtxHPVre_Jzovf_XpDtItStCPVvhc_rJf-_ljJX2bjHEWIM-7kXrZwThvhL8h9LFAM_AQAA__8M3XPK). Popeil essentially invented the format. He started hawking kitchen gadgets at 16 on Chicago's Maxwell Street, then took his pitch to television in 1959 [with the Chop-O-Matic](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGngS3oOBNsDx6qtnRK14yWwWdwZccRXEB5-yp9ha7fJ_2G__ViLy6meJu_XSbDodgbHVsiZlptdrO7u4ndOhNvOXqmNW9bdhYB-xOoEwrrJo472c7V3gQiJFGTaaWSndRnfa4XIzWADwCjVmf0EASOUgC26En1rW7raF4eKBQtQC9E0yFiCJ2aFHryWlcdkI9c1uanxBsvFNKz7LQ2U8l1MgvzfavEW4VDhcNxHM2zPPgx0ut_LY6npRLDXomP4avIq83j9f2zXo2_HzGluPWy6mDOLqY_kv9ZYjf4GwAA__9qTnHd)**.** His company, Ronco, became a household name, and when the FCC relaxed its rules on program-length commercials in 1984, the floodgates opened. Suddenly, every insomniac in America was a captive audience for the Veg-O-Matic, [the Pocket Fisherman](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVuQOTuABw-Vqmzpmm7oyp3BqR1SfAHl7av0Fbp-n_Qb_pfzcMaY4m36wMxewjLceC-JRXgdMk54x1FwnVhKjiS85lIyDqChPej-AGbAUeLGg8WKfGAGNhX7pus727mjO1azb4_WMgUiR2iJddM7bBxpMJ1tCHUV_cvTPZhG69aY2gJACLYfeyAm55TVTFGWtb4u8SYzh_RcNl7rcclV8rPIvSjzpuCk4LTve_1cHvL44tf_WlDGWZnTpsz743oxP8GF5-d3tXq67zGlWNpOWT1ljOmPlH-W2Dz8BgAA__99W3NX), the Flowbee, and Popeil's masterpiece--the Showtime Rotisserie, which moved over a billion dollars in sales on the strength of four unforgettable words: "_Set it and forget it_." Other pitchmen followed. Billy Mays brought his thundering "_Hi, Billy Mays here!_ " to OxiClean. Kevin Trudeau sold millions of diet books before a federal judge sent him to prison for fraud. The format became so iconic that SNL parodied it repeatedly, starting with [Dan Aykroyd's legendary Bass-O-Matic sketch](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFurDAQheGnMd0iMzbYFC6udEW3SZkSzZqxcWQvCGZB-_YReYW050hf8X_dxzumnJ7xAws5Dsv4pHPPxEzbWDDiip5xi8R7SRPTVva94AgSupu0N1Ajek4HjRqryQUiIFWRa4w12vRt31azC9qHvgFvje1aUmh8E3qNpm1lQNmoKrnLkxZUI2WnVK0BIARtvYWJpr4XWtKUeNnq7yU9eaaQ38tBW-2XUmU3M6-7UP8EDAKG8zzr9_Li14Ou_1qQ_SzUcAj1P65xTXh-Do9YbW5az5Rz2jsjtIwFU_4l-Y8lDgc_AQAA__9FNXM1) in 1976. Then the audience vanished. Streaming killed the graveyard slot. Mays died in 2009 at 50. Popeil followed in 2021 at 86. Ronco filed for bankruptcy and was liquidated in 2018. But the infomercial didn't really die--it just moved. Today's version is TikTok Shop, where energetic creators demo products live with a buy button baked right in. The platform is projected to top $20 billion in U.S. sales this year, and one creator with fewer than 40,000 followers pulled in nearly $2 million in a single month. The TikTok Shop DNA is pure Popeil: charismatic personality, live demo, manufactured urgency, impulse buy. He just would've needed a shorter pitch. _Did you ever buy a Ronco product? Or another product advertised on an infomercial? Let us know your thoughts by replying to this email._

If you ever found yourself wide awake at 2 a.m., mesmerized by a man slicing tomatoes paper-thin while shouting "But wait, there's more! " then you already know about the golden age of TV infomercials. And odds are, . Popeil essentially invented the format. He started hawking kitchen gadgets at 16 on Chicago's Maxwell Street, then took his pitch to television in 1959 . His company, Ronco, became a household name, and when the FCC relaxed its rules on program-length commercials in 1984, the floodgates opened. Suddenly, every insomniac in America was a captive audience for the Veg-O-Matic, , the Flowbee, and Popeil's masterpiece--the Showtime Rotisserie, which moved over a billion dollars in sales on the strength of four unforgettable words: "Set it and forget it." Other pitchmen followed. Billy Mays brought his thundering "Hi, Billy Mays here! " to OxiClean. Kevin Trudeau sold millions of diet books before a federal judge sent him to prison for fraud. The format became so iconic that SNL parodied it repeatedly, starting with in 1976. Then the audience vanished. Streaming killed the graveyard slot. Mays died in 2009 at 50. Popeil followed in 2021 at 86. Ronco filed for bankruptcy and was liquidated in 2018. But the infomercial didn't really die--it just moved. Today's version is TikTok Shop, where energetic creators demo products live with a buy button baked right in. The platform is projected to top $20 billion in U.S. sales this year, and one creator with fewer than 40,000 followers pulled in nearly $2 million in a single month. The TikTok Shop DNA is pure Popeil: charismatic personality, live demo, manufactured urgency, impulse buy. He just would've needed a shorter pitch. Did you ever buy a Ronco product? ## Austin Woman Chasing All 89 Parks
Emma Keteler quit her corporate job in January to [visit every one of Texas' 89 state parks](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ_G7jaCNTZQUPxNuvztlRaxl3h1BCxATvL2p-Qe4erRfJpvvi7zxXPkdPvv7-TaM-Q50aNGao3KbOzuy3flJF_kS-BCOe3RJ5pR4ATCAA6zXxofNCvfr-4qVit7clIbrQxaJfrNBUFKhonshFaOqx6vRl8V0jL5QEYPPbs3ThgcpBQozSlov_jBjBgWbUdDnRK0csvl1DZq9PQ1xFc-qJyWfO-j21rbazf86_Dc4XmnvEd6Rx2e28YV0MJbAHJcgSscXLlxuoGPEYyFDxFq843gIwycICf6LW1UCCo8thdIFJMyyvbFrfuDY-Q66U6J291z_Gxpf_3wcPgTAAD__yzphmE) before the year is out. The 29-year-old Austin social media manager is at 49 and counting, with a November wedding squeezing what's left. One stretch got her 11 parks in seven days. Three rules govern every stop: camp where camping is the draw, swim wherever swimming is allowed, and do whatever the park is best known for. That has meant 35-degree plunges in January and tent nights at 85 degrees. Caprock Canyons ranks near the top of her favorites list so far, with red-rock cliffs and the [state bison herd](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAUheGnwVssuBCDB4Yu3tK1o3VjLgkqAQTITt6-Sl6h-9Ennf_nsl4wxJBu3_gg258-r4mOFql3qquZC9bfFpJ4EVYfKuVUIiZagcN04uYEcsWth51WhYOzV-5mMZAV2mhlYFZ8uFvFt0k6MWlB3ihltEBzBQ5qwk3OUgzBvjluQArBQZjRa9xQmjP4Tc9nQ0xxcqHnOvY7dXpi8_GVd6rjlh9DtPfeS2Pyi8HCYOnlcONnNd7yzmBpxVHrDJb3m5B8ZrBcQ8tpqNaVI8QY2qSZ4rcHhvgx-39b7Bb-AgAA__-DIXMd) roaming loose. So does Daingerfield in East Texas, a spring-fed lake ringed by pines. Keteler had camped exactly once before she turned 21.

## Officer Commandeers Uber To Chase Suspect
A Houston police officer jumped into a stranger's Uber and [told the driver](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQheGnwd1EeIINFC62cXe33dKawDhGF4MFOL55-1X2FbY-0pG-_8_X8kUhhvT8TTtP7WfNS-KrRm6Ny2LsQeW7htS_mcoaCud0REq8oMQRpAG8L-RaePGiqPPTQ3rbdzz12mhl0CrZbROPfrSm742Rbh2dH1nRwDgoh2qUeujC9LmTBu99L7E3t1WTo7sZcHXaDoaFkuxDy-XWNm78Q3WN7_zicnN57-K0tXZUcf8lcBY4X9d1-97y-RkFzlRacJEFzh-ZwDlmR1HgvOWztpzgyDE4BpfP6FMDR81tQLBG5pCeUM96sGtQM7SN3-DyvlPyzIU9UILzwUXgjGYAerBH9AgjewMKHxasVg40Wcs9Dtor05XJH1eIMdRRCyWfO4X4z9H-t_9rwr8BAAD__35cmaI) to go after a fleeing suspect. It started Aug. 7 with a terroristic threat call. Police say a woman at an apartment pool with her children argued with a man who then threatened to shoot them. Officers taking her statement tried to detain the man when he stepped outside. He slipped their grip and ran. Driver Anthony Baines was stopped nearby when the suspect crossed in front of his car and an officer climbed in. "_Go, go, go, go!_ " the officer yelled, [according to Baines' video](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAURb9GOwwgo1hQbGM3225pnvgYXxbBAOrM329ms3-w7c3NzT3n6z7dgTyFxydsaMrTxSnglT2WgmnSww7pO1MQL4TkKGEMu4eAk-SyY1wz2U5gC504KagXM_NlEDUa0eteaTkoXq9mhqVr1XCTwgmnuHIwD9ZqjdC12Dlek3nPcS1bIbgUunE9WGj1TTrbDzeNleK4UImpKSsWfEJ2_hVPTI2NW-3NWsqeq_ajkmMlx-u6GhefslvjkUsM71IlxzdXJce_kO3Rk0UWnSOLKTMbtw3CgpjYMWNiJ65kPbLlSBQebD9SPqiwfOQdbamTWfaLvKfc9ZXijw3I_74p_7V4GvkTAAD__2S8iy8). Baines drove them around the block to the complex, where the officer got back in his own car. The suspect got away, and the case remains open.

The 29-year-old Austin social media manager is at 49 and counting, with a November wedding squeezing what's left. One stretch got her 11 parks in seven days. Three rules govern every stop: camp where camping is the draw, swim wherever swimming is allowed, and do whatever the park is best known for. That has meant 35-degree plunges in January and tent nights at 85 degrees. Caprock Canyons ranks near the top of her favorites list so far, with red-rock cliffs and the roaming loose. So does Daingerfield in East Texas, a spring-fed lake ringed by pines. Keteler had camped exactly once before she turned 21. The pilot of Flight 2398 told the tower that four to five passengers had been burned and asked for medical crews on the ground. The Airbus A321 was carrying 133 people. Flight attendants contained the device, and the plane under its own power. One person was treated at the scene and released. American Airlines confirmed smoke came from . Officer Commandeers Uber To Chase Suspect A Houston police officer jumped into a stranger's Uber and to go after a fleeing suspect. It started Aug. 7 with a terroristic threat call. Police say a woman at an apartment pool with her children argued with a man who then threatened to shoot them. Officers taking her statement tried to detain the man when he stepped outside. He slipped their grip and ran. Driver Anthony Baines was stopped nearby when the suspect crossed in front of his car and an officer climbed in. "Go, go, go, go! " the officer yelled, . Baines drove them around the block to the complex, where the officer got back in his own car. Now we're going to get biblical values back into public schools.
| | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcGOmzAQhp_G3BzB2Bhz4JCIEEVqulEqbY_WYA_EK8AITKq-fUW3-wK9fvpnNP98P2_mhn7wU_8dR6r6MM9mWc0vPwy_w_akYZ63GJ_U-nagFq2BFBRPNQdh0Eb_IiMxcZVEJZVSCVVZoQupC5UVybPSDlVWoCjbUqoSJJS27XJQIhcuc0okvtoXphpEBpBm-QGty4VOMy2p0J3umEzJ-RiWw37bQqt3NEWPw8GGMRmqZ4zzysSRQcOgWcluCx1wIhfinmDQtAu-iHdh4X0IjkEzo4NWcynalKOEj_GD51q0GjptCTMmmi2OZg3bYomJ-nF-Z6B2NJLz28hEfb4dr9_-QYvjjL6fmKg_q2SlOdUXc2oub-Zxfjd_w-Z0fVx_8PuRX97u96_RMEWaIhP1DvnXJ5KlcvNuwK-qYDLtR_SfdeP_CnpV8CcAAP__LQmbzQ)" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. **And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family.** It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. **[That's why I'm spearheading a nationwide Bible Revival in public schools and asking you to join me today.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcGOmzAQhp_G3BzB2Bhz4JCIEEVqulEqbY_WYA_EK8AITKq-fUW3-wK9fvpnNP98P2_mhn7wU_8dR6r6MM9mWc0vPwy_w_akYZ63GJ_U-nagFq2BFBRPNQdh0Eb_IiMxcZVEJZVSCVVZoQupC5UVybPSDlVWoCjbUqoSJJS27XJQIhcuc0okvtoXphpEBpBm-QGty4VOMy2p0J3umEzJ-RiWw37bQqt3NEWPw8GGMRmqZ4zzysSRQcOgWcluCx1wIhfinmDQtAu-iHdh4X0IjkEzo4NWcynalKOEj_GD51q0GjptCTMmmi2OZg3bYomJ-nF-Z6B2NJLz28hEfb4dr9_-QYvjjL6fmKg_q2SlOdUXc2oub-Zxfjd_w-Z0fVx_8PuRX97u96_RMEWaIhP1DvnXJ5KlcvNuwK-qYDLtR_SfdeP_CnpV8CcAAP__LQmbzQ)** Your signature on your "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcGOmzAQhp_G3BzB2Bhz4JCIEEVqulEqbY_WYA_EK8AITKq-fUW3-wK9fvpnNP98P2_mhn7wU_8dR6r6MM9mWc0vPwy_w_akYZ63GJ_U-nagFq2BFBRPNQdh0Eb_IiMxcZVEJZVSCVVZoQupC5UVybPSDlVWoCjbUqoSJJS27XJQIhcuc0okvtoXphpEBpBm-QGty4VOMy2p0J3umEzJ-RiWw37bQqt3NEWPw8GGMRmqZ4zzysSRQcOgWcluCx1wIhfinmDQtAu-iHdh4X0IjkEzo4NWcynalKOEj_GD51q0GjptCTMmmi2OZg3bYomJ-nF-Z6B2NJLz28hEfb4dr9_-QYvjjL6fmKg_q2SlOdUXc2oub-Zxfjd_w-Z0fVx_8PuRX97u96_RMEWaIhP1DvnXJ5KlcvNuwK-qYDLtR_SfdeP_CnpV8CcAAP__LQmbzQ)" petition tells our representatives that you want biblical lessons put back in schools. And **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - **back into public schools this year!** HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. **[With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America's 250th Anniversary.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcGOmzAQhp_G3BzB2Bhz4JCIEEVqulEqbY_WYA_EK8AITKq-fUW3-wK9fvpnNP98P2_mhn7wU_8dR6r6MM9mWc0vPwy_w_akYZ63GJ_U-nagFq2BFBRPNQdh0Eb_IiMxcZVEJZVSCVVZoQupC5UVybPSDlVWoCjbUqoSJJS27XJQIhcuc0okvtoXphpEBpBm-QGty4VOMy2p0J3umEzJ-RiWw37bQqt3NEWPw8GGMRmqZ4zzysSRQcOgWcluCx1wIhfinmDQtAu-iHdh4X0IjkEzo4NWcynalKOEj_GD51q0GjptCTMmmi2OZg3bYomJ-nF-Z6B2NJLz28hEfb4dr9_-QYvjjL6fmKg_q2SlOdUXc2oub-Zxfjd_w-Z0fVx_8PuRX97u96_RMEWaIhP1DvnXJ5KlcvNuwK-qYDLtR_SfdeP_CnpV8CcAAP__LQmbzQ)** That's why **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed "**[Schools Need a Bible Revival](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcGOmzAQhp_G3BzB2Bhz4JCIEEVqulEqbY_WYA_EK8AITKq-fUW3-wK9fvpnNP98P2_mhn7wU_8dR6r6MM9mWc0vPwy_w_akYZ63GJ_U-nagFq2BFBRPNQdh0Eb_IiMxcZVEJZVSCVVZoQupC5UVybPSDlVWoCjbUqoSJJS27XJQIhcuc0okvtoXphpEBpBm-QGty4VOMy2p0J3umEzJ-RiWw37bQqt3NEWPw8GGMRmqZ4zzysSRQcOgWcluCx1wIhfinmDQtAu-iHdh4X0IjkEzo4NWcynalKOEj_GD51q0GjptCTMmmi2OZg3bYomJ-nF-Z6B2NJLz28hEfb4dr9_-QYvjjL6fmKg_q2SlOdUXc2oub-Zxfjd_w-Z0fVx_8PuRX97u96_RMEWaIhP1DvnXJ5KlcvNuwK-qYDLtR_SfdeP_CnpV8CcAAP__LQmbzQ)** " petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, **BRAVE FOR GOOD** will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. **[But that means getting your signed "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition back now. | | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
Good morning. It's Chris Deluzio.

While I am 100% certain you did not wake up this morning, jump out of bed and scream at the top of your lungs, "I am going to make a contribution to Chris Deluzio's campaign today!!!" ... That is what I have to ask you to do.

Here's why:

I am the last Democrat in Pennsylvania who represents a battleground seat. Over the past few elections, we have won by single digits while running ahead of the presidential nominee in 2024.

That makes me a target for Republicans desperate to find seats to help them hold the House.

body:
#

Friends --
In just one week, we close the books on our August 31 fundraising deadline — one of the last monthly deadlines before the midterm elections.
When this deadline is over, we'll take stock of our resources and make some tough decisions about where we can afford to make investments... and where we can't.
That's why we're asking you to donate today. $5. That's the ask.
$5 to help us expand strong gun laws in states where Democrats have the numbers to act.
$5 to help us fight back against Republican attempts to erode our gun laws in Congress or in states they have the numbers to act.
$5 to help us elect a Congress that will stand up to Donald Trump, MAGA extremists, and those who prioritize the profits of gun manufacturers over the safety of our communities.
We know that $5 may not seem like it can do all of those things. But when so many people are chipping in what they can on the days they can, it adds up fast. So please:
[**Before the weekend ends: Make a contribution — $5 or whatever you can afford — to GIFFORDS PAC and we will put your donation to work in the fight to make our communities safe from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260823-1-b&t=1&akid=11753%2E3935704%2Eh1DHF0)

_As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene._I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend.When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, _I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way._**But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different.

**That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field.

And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work.

That is not an accident. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | | Fellow Conservative, Let that sink in: Democrats just voted to abolish U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Not a fringe activist. Not a socialist backbencher. The National Democrat Party -- on the record -- deciding that the men and women who arrest violent criminal illegal aliens, dismantle trafficking rings, and secure our communities should not exist. [**They don't want reform. They want U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement gone. Full stop.**](https://trk.email.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9QSC1BYm9saXNoLUlDRV8yMDI2MDgyMSZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBILUFib2xpc2gtSUNFJnV0bV9hZ2VuY3k9UEcmYW1vdW50PTU1In0/vUGUG1E7osslJwAqO71drw) Think about what that actually means. No agency to detain and remove violent criminals who are here illegally. No enforcement at all. Open borders by design, not by accident. Hampshire’s airwaves with attack ads.

they know what happens here could decide control of the Senate.

and try to drown out our message to voters.

families.

Peter, have you
seen this headline?

and is planning a $15 million effort against democratic socialism.

Instead of embracing the next generation of bold, progressive leaders
generating excitement and winning Democratic primaries across the country,
the Democratic establishment would rather fight them.

The corporate-backed Democratic elite resisted and attacked candidates
like Zohran Mamdani and Abdul El-Sayed, along with Justice Democrats like
Darializa Avila-Chevalier, Chris Rabb, and Melat Kiros, who won their
races with a shared commitment to fighting for what the people want:
Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, affordable housing for all, the end to
U.S. funded genocide and forever wars, and holding Big Tech like AI and
Crypto accountable.

Establishment Democrats could embrace these bold solutions and the
working-class champions behind them, but that would require them to reject
campaign checks from their corporate donors and the Israel lobby, which
they refuse to do.

Now, groups like Third Way — which is largely funded by Big Pharma, health
insurance companies like BlueCross BlueShield, and other corporate
lobbyists — are declaring war on the Left, promising to spend tens of
millions of dollars to stop democratic socialists and progressives from
winning future elections.

That money could be spent on fighting Donald Trump’s worsening fascism and
dangerous MAGA extremists, but they’d rather use it to stop a
people-powered movement that's already energizing & winning Democratic
voters.

We said it at the beginning of the 2026 cycle: Party leaders can either
learn from their mistakes, listen to their voters, and clean house, or
they can fight us and lose at the ballot box.

This has been Justice Democrats' most successful cycle EVER, with at least

name: R. Cooper
subject: Not asking for your money
body:
I don’t stand a chance at winning without you on my side.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1148&source=&t=1&akid=2895%2E124072%2Eq64MV_)

---
Peter, I’m not asking for your money. Let me explain.
President Trump has endorsed my MAGA opponent and attacked me online. Stephen Miller has gone on Fox News to rant and rave about me. GOP dark-money groups are spending millions to run ads statewide with baseless lies about my record.
**Simply put, I can’t win this race without people like you on my side.**
So all I’m asking is that you be one of the 30,000 folks l need to endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina today. [**_Will you take 30 seconds now to add your name?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1148&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=2895%2E124072%2Eq64MV_)

---
I have spent my life trying to do right by the people of North Carolina.
Whether as a state legislator or Attorney General or Governor, I’ve fought hard to protect our fundamental rights, expand health care and put working families first.
**I’m running to take this critical work to Washington DC – but right now, the GOP is spending more in North Carolina than any other battleground this cycle to defeat me.**
I know we have what it takes to flip this seat for the first time since 2008, but the only way it happens is if thousands of people like you stand with me in this fight.
[**_So if you’re ready to win in North Carolina, take back the Senate and prevent two more years of unchecked Republican rule, will you endorse my grassroots campaign today?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1148&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=2895%2E124072%2Eq64MV_)

I really appreciate it.

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

clean_body: | Fellow American, it's Michele Tafoya, and you need to hear about what happened. I was on the ground for a professional women's basketball game recently, and it's astonishing to me how this has become ground zero for the Left's latest culture wars. I heard firsthand, Leftist activists shouting obscene remarks at women, simply for saying that men don't belong in girls' sports. | As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene.I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend.When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way.But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different. That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field. And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work. Women's sports should belong to women.Fellow American, if you can agree with me on that, then I have a feeling we'll be aligned on plenty of other things.Unfortunately, my far-Left candidate is not the same. I started Truth to Power because I was done watching Washington cut deals for the people writing the biggest checks — while working families keep getting left behind.

name: Sue AnderBois
subject: All Hands on Deck! Join us Monday night to get energized & plugged in the final two weeks!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of AnderBois
body:
| |
---
Hi friend, It has been so encouraging to receive notes from supporters around the state who have already cast their ballot. I am so grateful for all the incredible Rhode Islanders doing their share to fight for a stronger democracy, and for the progressive future we deserve! But there are still thousands more voters who have yet to make their decision. With **only 18 days left** , we need all hands on deck to get people out to vote. This looks different for everyone. Whether it's knocking doors, sharing a social media post, donating, driving an older neighbor to the polls, writing an op-ed, or more, **now** is the time to take that one extra step. One of my greatest strengths is knowing how to effectively leverage everyone's unique backgrounds and capabilities (which is just one small part of the new energy I am excited to bring to the Lieutenant Governor's office). Oftentimes, the hardest part is knowing where to start. Fortunately, I have the perfect opportunity for you -- and one that doesn't even require you to step out of your living room. Join me tomorrow night, **Monday****August 24th, at 7pm for a virtual gathering** to get your burning questions answered, learn about my plan to take big action as Rhode Island’s next Lieutenant Governor, meet an amazing community of “do-ers,” and get excited to be a part of a progressive, results-driven movement.
---
[ **SIGN UP HERE** ](https://sue4ri.com/8-24-virtual-house-party?t=mMAgjGuzsfDa)

Friends, we wanted to make sure you saw this. **Trump’s Department of Justice is pushing forward with sending over 1,000 federal monitors to our polling places.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137775652/641906973/1071238059?refcode=em-8.23.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NTUxOTFmZi0wZDlmLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t7tj5NPb52aiSC47UubZtpV2Y3Pvtrl6WjVE_eEGhdg=) **[We’ll explain more about what’s at stake this November shortly, but will you chip in $3 right now to support Democratic Secretaries of State in their fight to defend our election systems?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137775653/641906974/1071238059?refcode=em-8.23.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NTUxOTFmZi0wZDlmLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t7tj5NPb52aiSC47UubZtpV2Y3Pvtrl6WjVE_eEGhdg=)** | | | **[DONATE $3](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137775654/641906975/1071238059?refcode=em-8.23.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NTUxOTFmZi0wZDlmLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t7tj5NPb52aiSC47UubZtpV2Y3Pvtrl6WjVE_eEGhdg=)**
---
****
Here’s what’s going on, friends:
Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon announced that federal monitors will be heading out to our polling places in November. This comes after Trump sent election monitors to Michigan, Florida, and Wyoming during this month’s primaries.
We know Trump said he would do _“anything necessary”_ to preserve our _“honest elections.”_ **But what Trump thinks as only honest elections are the ones he wins.**
Election officials are facing immense pressure from the Trump administration to hand over unredacted voter data – intimidation tactics aimed at officials just trying to keep our elections running smoothly, with zero help from federal agencies.
This administration is propping up false conspiracy theories that our elections are unsecure. That voter fraud is rampant. That there’s foreign interference.
Take a moment to think about how extreme that is. It is exactly why Democratic Secretaries of State matter so much right now.
They are the people working to ensure voters can cast ballots safely, election workers can do their jobs without intimidation, and the democratic process remains independent from political pressure like this.

clean_body: He ran on Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, and taxing away wealth, backed by Bernie Sanders and the furthest-left wing of the party. | Fellow patriot, I want to walk you through what happened in Michigan a couple of weeks ago, because it is the clearest warning yet of where this is headed. On August 4, a progressive named Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic nomination for Michigan's open United States Senate seat. He ran on Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, and taxing away wealth, backed by Bernie Sanders and the furthest-left wing of the party. Here is what makes it a warning shot. El-Sayed did not beat some no-name. He beat the candidate hand-picked by the Democratic establishment, the one backed by Governor Whitmer, by the retiring senator, and by Chuck Schumer himself. More than sixty million dollars poured in to stop him, and it failed. Think about that. This movement just proved it can win a United States Senate nomination in a presidential battleground state, over the objection of the entire Democratic leadership. That should alarm every one of us. Michigan is not Brooklyn. President Trump carried it in 2024. And that Senate seat could decide control of the chamber this November. It matters. Gratefully, John Hoeven | | Paid for by Hoeven for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go: .

They’re calling in favors from their billionaire pals in West Hollywood and New York to dump a tidal wave of out-of-state cash into Georgia. **They want to keep Ossoff in office so he can keep doing what he’s been doing:** **> > Voting against border security** while I had to write and pass the Laken Riley Act just to get federal law enforcement to hold illegal alien criminals. **> > Pushing taxpayer-funded benefits like Medicaid for illegal immigrants** while hard-working Georgians get crushed by inflation. **> > Rubber-stamping liberal, activist judges** who spend their days trying to block the America First agenda from the bench. **> > Supporting schemes to pack the Supreme Court** and scrap the Senate filibuster so they can pass their radical agenda with zero opposition. **If Chuck Schumer and the Left seize control of the Senate, it won’t just hurt Georgia – it will ruin the entire country.** They’ll dismantle the filibuster and strip away your rights before you can even catch your breath.

Peter, A few weeks ago I wrote to you about Keith Self whipping up a crowd at the McKinney City Council over a planned mosque that had spent two years meeting every requirement the city has. **The story has only grown since, and it has taken a darker turn than I thought even Self's hatred was capable of.** The council did its job and approved the site plan 7 to 0, because the law left them no other honest option. So now Keith Self is backing a recall petition to unseat McKinney's mayor and councilmembers, most of them Republicans, as punishment for refusing to break the law on his racist command. **A sitting member of Congress is using his federal office to tear down his own hometown's government because it would not bend to his bigotry.** That is shameful and inexcusable. body:
We’ll teach you everything you need to know to raise money for the swing districts Democrats must win this fall.
#
Hi there,
Your friends, family, neighbors, and coworkers are more powerful than you might think, and in these next 10 weeks before Election Day, you can put those relationships to work.
We know we can’t just aim for a narrow majority in 2026. We need to help Democrats win decisively and build the lasting governing power required to protect democracy for years to come.
That work can start right in our own backyards, living rooms, and local communities. You don’t need to wait for an official campaign to roll into town to make a difference–you can help Democrats secure Must-Win swing districts and states from wherever you are.
Over the next month, Swing Left is hosting weekly onboarding events to show you how to host your own Grassroots Fundraising Event and activate your personal network, turning everyday interactions and connections into political action.
That might mean inviting five friends over for coffee, hosting a backyard BBQ, throwing a bake sale, or organizing a themed party. However you gather people, you’re creating a space where the people you know can connect their values to action.
And you don’t need event planning experience or a wealthy network to host a successful fundraising event. All you need is a passion for protecting our democracy and a willingness to invite your community. Every gathering centers on a simple, personal pitch: explaining why this moment matters to you and asking guests to donate, volunteer, or both.
[**Swing Left will equip you with everything you need—so, to learn how simple it is to host and gather what you need to get started, RSVP to join us on Tuesday, August 25th from 7:30 - 8:30 PM ET for our next virtual onboarding session.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2250?utm_source=em20260823-2543&t=1&akid=2543%2E1562180%2EKk6BV2)
Over the years, Swing Left volunteers have raised millions of dollars for Democrats in swing districts and states through personal fundraising pages and Grassroots Fundraising Events. Two Hunter Biden emails in one week. I know. Stay with me.
We had him for an hour on Wednesday, in his garage, with the paintings behind him, and he kept answering questions the way people answer them when nobody has prepped them and nobody upstairs has to approve it. David Shuster asked him where Kamala Harris fits into all of this. Watch it above! ⬆
He started generous, and he meant it--Doug and the vice president have always been kind to him personally. Then he flagged what was coming as the part he probably was not supposed to say, and said it anyway.
_**" I just think that she's not a very good politician."**_
On her running from Joe Biden's record, he would not give her a pass on what he called the disloyalty of it. "It leaves a distaste in my mouth," he said. And then, separating the personal from the professional: "I think it is also just stupid politics."
Then he did the math out loud. Eighty-one million people voted for his father. Not merely against Trump--because those people never showed up again, for anyone. He described the waitress in Green Bay with three kids and an Uber shift on the side, whose husband drives a truck, who goes to mass on Sunday, and who voted for Joe Biden eagerly because she believed he knew what her life was actually like.
Run away from that at your peril, he said.
As far as we can tell, that is the first time he has said any of it on the record. It happened on our show.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a3a2146d-300f-4373-9a92-7b7ba44fc85a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And that was one answer out of an hour. He walked through Don Jr.'s scorecard--$3.9 billion in defense contracts to a private equity shop formed weeks before the inauguration--while the political press is somehow still asking about his paintings, which earned about $200,000 a year from buyers who each had to testify to Congress under oath. He challenged Don Jr. to a UFC fight for the third time and noted that only one of them would pass the required drug test. He described what he said to Matt Gaetz behind closed doors about drug use. And he took Jake Tapper apart, on camera, by name.
#### Here is the ask, and I am going to make it plainly.
That interview happened because there was no network lawyer, no corporate parent, and no booker worried about losing access next month. Hunter Biden sat down with us and told the truth as he sees it, unvarnished, and we ran it unvarnished. That is the entire product. [It is also expensive to make, and the only people paying for it are subscribers](https://substack.com/redirect/4f9e8a21-60d1-4b13-b787-c68acdeb254c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This clip is free. Most of what we do now is not, because it cannot be.
There are seventy-two days until the midterms. For the next seventy-two days, the corporate outlets are going to do what they did in 2024--platform the liars, fact-check nobody, and then write the book about it afterward. We are going to do the opposite, four live shows a week, and you can watch every minute of it.

body:
The dysfunction at the DNC is clear as day.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260823-1&t=1&akid=3911%2E587540%2E0jStC7)

While legacy party insiders stay mired in internal dysfunction, we can’t afford to wait around for DNC leadership to wake up. **That’s why, day in and day out, Leaders We Deserve is doing the work the party establishment refuses to do.**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | ★ Office of Mike Rogers | A Personal Message

Friend, I'm standing here in my office, and I have to be completely raw with you for a moment.
Two years ago, I stood in this exact same spot. I gave everything I had to this state--the state where I was born, where I served as an FBI agent and Army veteran, and where my wife Kristi and I built our lives.

Long days of door-knocking and phone-banking take fuel. And there's one secret weapon that every campaign needs...
| | | | | [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f43oQw-LLl6Xkrnq5IZSVUYG154S4hYJHaHBIALmOVrAn_fEHfUNYQrMteFoYmoexA4PeXmriVkWI3WjRWeJqdT8hH6QYr-SgEzhwxh6S_IYbg-MNMwTShy4zTl3fxmJmb2ppEiCbFyHhXikkDX7dxeWhfNyVW76dVZFiOplp975CN1iEstkRN7sxUJZR2uKPoVjOuwVgpeXkLBMQMIOiL_5e65A2SBt&c=TfVmSvM7uHDQHySyeItA8qEz2i1kYrqt6V4ebAQ0HiW1I6MAGkPv2w==&ch=-EmW3yPlxsM8JKHSWTy-eO6mCC9g1cIE50mf8cGx_VygKxR0VWzyVQ==)

Peter,
Right now, all across Nebraska, our paid staff and volunteers are out knocking doors, working phones, and showing up in communities that campaigns usually write off.
They're doing the hard work required to flip this U.S. Senate seat, one conversation at a time. Meeting neighbors on their porches. Listening to what's actually keeping them up at night: the cost of groceries, the price of prescriptions, whether their kids will be able to afford to stay in Nebraska or how data centers impact their towns. And then making the case, face to face, for how Democrats will fight for them.
---
| [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f43oQw-LLl6Xkrnq5IZSVUYG154S4hYJHaHBIALmOVrAn_fEHfUNYQrMteFoYmoexA4PeXmriVkWI3WjRWeJqdT8hH6QYr-SgEzhwxh6S_IYbg-MNMwTShy4zTl3fxmJmb2ppEiCbFyHhXikkDX7dxeWhfNyVW76dVZFiOplp975CN1iEstkRN7sxUJZR2uKPoVjOuwVgpft0x07S-OqcAERU6QZrUBg&c=TfVmSvM7uHDQHySyeItA8qEz2i1kYrqt6V4ebAQ0HiW1I6MAGkPv2w==&ch=-EmW3yPlxsM8JKHSWTy-eO6mCC9g1cIE50mf8cGx_VygKxR0VWzyVQ==)
---
And their work is paying off. Dan Osborn is statistically tied with MAGA Senator Pete Ricketts, well within the margin of error. A mechanic, a Navy veteran, taking on a billionaire's son in a seat Republicans thought was safe.
Our two House seats are on the national radar with NE2 Denise Powell in the lead and NE1 Chris Backemeyer making massive gains towards victory.
Nebraska is winnable, and our team on the ground is a huge reason why.
But our team can't run on empty. Long days of door-knocking and phone-banking take fuel. And there's one secret weapon that every campaign needs...pizza.
That's where you come in. There are still 75 days until the election, and that means we'll need to order hundreds of pizzas by election day to keep our team fed, energized, and out in the field doing the work that will flip the US Senate blue.

Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. I didn't come to Washington because I love asking true patriots like you for money. I didn't run for Congress at 29 years old to become the youngest House Republican so I could spend my nights begging for donations. I came because my kids deserve to grow up in a better America than I grew up in — and right now, that's not guaranteed. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father Almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. I refuse to look my kids in the eye someday and tell them I gave up when it mattered most. [**That's why I'm still here. That's why I keep sending these messages.**](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/XtyKFztc74EWj6GHIRSscuZZDuZ6DiHv6u23VEQCJdok_5SJJtp-lighsvifDx0LmMFHGlnknHabjF_Jq2_LLUQtoltvzcLcwGrR8uVifEtQxoGhm34oGYKWlNULhCvLKSy8Qv5MsOt6oPqLZqaWcW4RazNXVPPpVLhUZcSD1-_3NuOqB0XVflqBg3nLvQlGwabP9wLn1CxQl0bjXjzEu8CWIz4UFI84hdDuBogGjg815RsuA1UbXhkntlLrEX5I5-wYmSpgiYWqhaiO2-dtpseDpXOL9DswAhFtO7K_UXI6RIeHMY0XT_UJtokIXz1Zml9c-8KudxUjWv50zN-ZoQgEYUe15QkT_WvLqafOWbl8HA4fGJsYZn92m94T1q1GYqsb6OmYqTOzIBQRNBCfcPr1Q66_6rNE48dD11RPcnQ9Nv3fcrv1LyztMFheeFFw5tIQgj4t9EagPE4rXf6f6ReXiwR51jySfH7ol98-mDid2l3aiohABOdMWfALXc5IXiUrT4Rz5AXrpb_0Mm88rb_yGNZ_W7k2U5X-c8r2mP6W3g4W9cJ2Al3amaIDdrdvSesF3bHYu_KTUVvPQNXWQmpLFd2e4laO5lOSg3LwShFqi66J1jxcoJxbCD1wmk4ks0Fgc4pcWHDR4QloPHf_4QHlQ5tbeaEZmp6HaPJu0Tvc2cj69qnLw-IF_eIx6B6-wwXewcLpVF7v90ypiJiQJGtkHkBroH0NUYD3QZTIHfsSWJUTRTjnuJCqDbbiahCaHzKNrHZ7xlpkXfnxwOnu_yPCI9OsOoiWSQuf3Ul8nqCcifw/A5HjrP0q2E3XXNWJn-z5KsJ35Fe8vC-p/23) Because nothing — I repeat — nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country. Friend,
Most gun owners NEVER see this part of the fight.
No courtroom. No cameras. Just a _**federal comment docket**_ , a hard deadline, and a stack of proposed rules that will govern how you buy, keep, and travel with your firearms for _years to come._
The ATF put **34 proposed and final rules** on the table this spring. Our Executive Director, Adam Kraut, was in the room when they were announced. The anti-gun lobby has been ___in an uproar_ _ever since._
**So we filed.**
Here is exactly what the Second Amendment Foundation formally asked the ATF to do:
1. Clear out the _**outdated barriers**_ to firearms transactions that do not happen face-to-face at a dealer's counter.
2. Put a reasonable limit back on how long dealers are _**forced to hold records**_ with _your name_ on them.
3. Strengthen _**protections for interstate travel**_ with _your firearms_ under the Gun Control Act and the Firearm Owners' Protection Act.
4. Cut the red tape that _**punishes lawfully owned NFA items**_ the moment they cross a state line.

[](http://links.m.rightnationalerts.com/s/c/neYPPGNTFGwKZJGJJ2jAs_Rv3Z67213N1Q177LhcnZaJWm-fX3Us9BhdDtj6typFXFyGe5fesuVNWMMYlIsru0iN-gPtY2rh2aaAxNVjRcd6WHn-p6uqSQCv-oBXHxu5HUBSoCfBYd7_Sb_mOMuTKb9udkdT9CDH4gSYZHzhPECyokyCQK_4OCrvh_voMTWXWWpHtYpgem7XOYxxiFZFNCuvAhkrW1tW9Y0P2DiH_MGcNb3vKamEIzwWOV8kQJ2An-PZM9ZKuwp86-bt2VC7v69UB3_9mix3SPUlvS5-EnQ21tSj3yr2VUfYBZEZNTCql6U3vM9rJ77I9c-oU0Wu5K1K_68iIsWOOJIVEl8tKnTOq5agsWSlGDl69GyB6MF8AZqw3YFxkBe6I4L1SV9LYbrXpEUp8bebKuyE40B1A5FVCHYaneNp-Oz8MBRuag-6jmx8dk0Mb8hJ54u599jUPIKqW1uN9MkgFCs1Z34kcyPbkAjtjD306V7xQG8foD0C6zGCJVJZVK82331aXwG1vs9NmP8pWJfi20ie1ASYgKOMztDtaIjJ2-XH6osh6E3-Uux-mgJMbiPOIgn-mbEvZD7rb-X2JCY1tx7WMlJC_1lQx7vqUNyzUSKfmxVP3QUDkWev1a1NNjC-2tF1thQEQs7yzrsdeGrPtZUqEmgrvx-f4MgYYusrjepJJETNlz5BoOi-oycHaMhjHMUVMGcuPBcQyC6HVf6_KelfZ7i4wAuLLC1Hv0gDSdDzYDsLG2apN4DmPuXeSA966FGx5Yde0QmHsQw9rtANonGJxTlkdB9f1TIuF5UtKhDqV0PIinsY0K5-aqXrtcUZctlsKTK1Cy-Pz_HuRcskU9ZVNgIa4nQTdPqSpxToQ4-34GhbimofdBNC/tZyp9lOc1LJOqdBTUMq8jwAwgHxbPAxS/23)

subject: Another reason to overturn Citizens United
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Elon Musk is planning to spend over $100 million on the midterms – we cannot let that happen.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260823-6632-footer&t=1&akid=6632%2E420207%2Er9500J)
Peter,
Elon Musk is jumping back into our elections — and he’s bringing his $900 billion checkbook with him.
He's reviving America PAC, the super PAC that spent more than _$260 million_ to put Trump back in office in 2024.
But this time, Elon is planning to spend _$100 million_ across the country to shape the outcome of the November midterms. Paid canvassers knocking doors, flashy digital ad spending, direct mail piling up on kitchen counters — **they're pulling out all the stops to protect Republican control of Congress and make sure billionaires like Musk and corporations keep calling the shots.**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260823-citizens-united-petition/?t=2&akid=6632%2E420207%2Er9500J)
Make no mistake: **this is a direct threat to our democracy.**
One man shouldn't be able to pour unlimited money into politics and buy our elections — especially not when control of Congress hangs in the balance this November.
**This is just the latest example of a rigged system, and why we need to overturn _Citizens United_.**
Our government belongs to the people, not whoever has the most zeros in their checkbook.
My entire career I’ve fought to get big money out of our politics. Since my very first election I've refused corporate PAC money. And I’ve made my constitutional amendment to overturn _Citizens United_ a top priority.
Elon and his allies aren’t going to let up, but neither am I. That’s why I need you standing with me in this fight — to help build the momentum we need to win. The momentum we need to save our democracy.
[**So, Peter, will you add your name to our petition demanding we overturn Citizens United and get big money out of politics for good?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260823-citizens-united-petition/?t=3&akid=6632%2E420207%2Er9500J)

subject: 🌶️ do you like green chile salsa, friend? 🌶️
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk1248-fr-nd&t=1&akid=11862%2E400544%2EfC05Cd)
---
Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. We made history by winning all 33 counties across New Mexico in the Democratic primary, officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor. I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16160?refcode=jtk1248-fr-nd&t=2&akid=11862%2E400544%2EfC05Cd)
---
This moment wouldn't be possible without the strong women who raised me and the values they passed down: work hard, care for your community, and always make room for others at the table. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community.

One of my _favorite_ New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me.

I love this recipe so much, in fact, that it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16160?refcode=jtk1248-fr-nd&t=3&akid=11862%2E400544%2EfC05Cd)
Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico.

I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand childcare, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment.
**That’s the kind of Governor I will be.**
**I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico.**
[**_Pl_** _**ease, if you believe in my vision for a brighter New Mexico, chip in $5 or whatever you can spare now to help me become the next Governor. When you click this link and donate, I'll share my own green chile salsa recipe with you! >>**_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16161?refcode=jtk1248-fr-nd&t=4&akid=11862%2E400544%2EfC05Cd)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16160?refcode=jtk1248-fr-nd&t=5&akid=11862%2E400544%2EfC05Cd)

Thank you for your support,

Deb

Dear Friend, With the exception of one more race, primary season has ended in every state where you have a Freedom Caucus.So this week we are giving you the whole picture.Montana had a monster night earlier this year, ten more states held serve or gained ground, and three states went the other way. We also are thrilled to report a dead union ballot measure in Arizona, a Missouri county that just ripped its surveillance cameras out of the ground, and a South Carolina caucus calling for a cabinet secretary's job.Let's get into it.
---
|
---
**PRIMARY SEASON WRAP-UP** Start with Montana, because Montana led the pack. Your **Montana Freedom Caucus** is going from 20 members to as many as 30 starting next year. That is a 50% jump in a single cycle, and it happened because the voters were sick of liberal Republicans teaming up with the Democrats to grow government. Then look at the map. Arizona, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina and West Virginia all held serve or picked up a few seats.Three did not. We lost several members in Idaho and South Dakota. And Wyoming was brutal. There is no way to dress that up, so we won't try. In Wyoming earlier this week, it was a perfect storm of Democrats crossing over and voting in the GOP primaries, Democrat and Establishment Republican groups working together to outspend our side, and negative messaging that didn't (because they couldn't) address all the amazing victories that the **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** pushed into law despite the Swamp's opposition. They passed historic tax relief. They passed school choice. They protected girls in their own sports and their own locker rooms. They made sure only citizens and residents vote in Wyoming elections. Despite the losses, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus isn't going away. They will continue to be the conservative North Star in the Cowboy State. And they are going to bring radical transparency into the legislature next year to make sure the Swamp doesn't undo all of the great conservative reforms that they fought so hard to secure. Finally, there was one massive victory in Wyoming from this past week. Secretary of State Chuck Gray, a founding member of the Wyoming Freedom Caucus, beat eight other Republicans on Tuesday to win the nomination for Wyoming's only seat in Congress. He'll be the heavy favorite to win in November. Chuck is a patriot and an outstanding defender of limited government and freedom.

**ARIZONA** The teachers' unions spent two years and millions of dollars trying to gut the state's gold standard school choice program that serves more than 100,000 Arizona kids.On Monday, the Arizona Supreme Court finished them off. Their Proposition 212 will not appear on the November ballot. As our friends at the Free Enterprise Club put it, the unions "spent millions trying to dismantle school choice and still failed to collect enough lawful, valid signatures."Now here is why this is an **Arizona Freedom Caucus** story and not just a court story. Earlier this summer, Arizona's establishment House Speaker Steve Montenegro tried to cut a deal: Republicans would agree to slap new regulations onto ESAs, and in exchange the union would drop its ballot measure.A DC-style trade, in Phoenix. The Arizona Freedom Caucus naturally opposed it and defeated it. AZFC Chairman Jake Hoffman said publicly that the union measure was going to fail on its own and that there was nothing to trade for.He was right. And the Arizona Freedom Caucus was proven correct. Arizona families get to keep their ESAs, and they gave up nothing in return. Bravo to Jake, to the AZFC members who held a united front, to the parents and grassroots activists who provided the air support, and to the Goldwater Institute and the Free Enterprise Club for doing the legal work.
---
|
---
**RADIO CLIP OF THE WEEK** Most legislators do not have a test. They are told how to vote by leadership and lobbyists and then they go find a reason afterwards.Our friend Rachel Keshel, who represents Legislative District 17 in the Arizona House and is a member of your **Arizona Freedom Caucus** , actually has a filter as does the rest of the AZFC.She walked us through it on the show, and it is short enough to fit on one screen. Take a listen...and then send it to your own state rep.

**QUICK HITS** **⚡️MISSOURI** : Last week we told you about **West Virginia Freedom Caucus Chairman Chris Anders** and his two-year fight to make the government get a warrant before tracking you with Flock cameras. This week a similar fight broke open in Missouri. A civilian employee of the St. Charles County Police Department got caught using the Flock system to track law-abiding people for personal reasons. Chief Kurt Frisz called the misuse "egregious," the employee was forced out, and the county bagged up all 28 cameras and cancelled Flock entirely. Now your **Missouri Freedom Caucus** , led by **Senator Nick Schroer** , is calling on every city and county in the state to do the same thing, and on the legislature to require a warrant when it convenes in 2027. **⚡️SOUTH CAROLINA** : Earlier this week, your **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** called for Commerce Secretary Harry M. Lightsey III to resign. Not one person at Commerce has faced a consequence for letting cost overruns balloon to $150 million on the Scout Motor corporate welfare scheme that the legislature approved three years ago. If Lightsey has not quit by the time the House is recalled for budget veto overrides, the SC Freedom Caucus says it will introduce legislation to remove him. The Swamp needs to be held accountable.
