clean_body: | | | | | Dear Friend, With the exception of one more race, primary season has ended in every state where you have a Freedom Caucus.So this week we are giving you the whole picture.Montana had a monster night earlier this year, ten more states held serve or gained ground, and three states went the other way. We also are thrilled to report a dead union ballot measure in Arizona, a Missouri county that just ripped its surveillance cameras out of the ground, and a South Carolina caucus calling for a cabinet secretary's job.Let's get into it. | PRIMARY SEASON WRAP-UP Start with Montana, because Montana led the pack. Your Montana Freedom Caucus is going from 20 members to as many as 30 starting next year. That is a 50% jump in a single cycle, and it happened because the voters were sick of liberal Republicans teaming up with the Democrats to grow government. Then look at the map. Arizona, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina and West Virginia all held serve or picked up a few seats.Three did not. We lost several members in Idaho and South Dakota. And Wyoming was brutal. There is no way to dress that up, so we won't try. In Wyoming earlier this week, it was a perfect storm of Democrats crossing over and voting in the GOP primaries, Democrat and Establishment Republican groups working together to outspend our side, and negative messaging that didn't (because they couldn't) address all the amazing victories that the Wyoming Freedom Caucus pushed into law despite the Swamp's opposition. They passed historic tax relief. They passed school choice. They protected girls in their own sports and their own locker rooms. They made sure only citizens and residents vote in Wyoming elections. Despite the losses, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus isn't going away. They will continue to be the conservative North Star in the Cowboy State. And they are going to bring radical transparency into the legislature next year to make sure the Swamp doesn't undo all of the great conservative reforms that they fought so hard to secure. Finally, there was one massive victory in Wyoming from this past week. Secretary of State Chuck Gray, a founding member of the Wyoming Freedom Caucus, beat eight other Republicans on Tuesday to win the nomination for Wyoming's only seat in Congress. He'll be the heavy favorite to win in November. Chuck is a patriot and an outstanding defender of limited government and freedom. | ARIZONA The teachers' unions spent two years and millions of dollars trying to gut the state's gold standard school choice program that serves more than 100,000 Arizona kids.On Monday, the Arizona Supreme Court finished them off. Their Proposition 212 will not appear on the November ballot. As our friends at the Free Enterprise Club put it, the unions "spent millions trying to dismantle school choice and still failed to collect enough lawful, valid signatures."Now here is why this is an Arizona Freedom Caucus story and not just a court story. Earlier this summer, Arizona's establishment House Speaker Steve Montenegro tried to cut a deal: Republicans would agree to slap new regulations onto ESAs, and in exchange the union would drop its ballot measure.A DC-style trade, in Phoenix. The Arizona Freedom Caucus naturally opposed it and defeated it. AZFC Chairman Jake Hoffman said publicly that the union measure was going to fail on its own and that there was nothing to trade for.He was right. And the Arizona Freedom Caucus was proven correct. Arizona families get to keep their ESAs, and they gave up nothing in return. Bravo to Jake, to the AZFC members who held a united front, to the parents and grassroots activists who provided the air support, and to the Goldwater Institute and the Free Enterprise Club for doing the legal work. | RADIO CLIP OF THE WEEK Most legislators do not have a test. They are told how to vote by leadership and lobbyists and then they go find a reason afterwards.Our friend Rachel Keshel, who represents Legislative District 17 in the Arizona House and is a member of your Arizona Freedom Caucus , actually has a filter as does the rest of the AZFC.She walked us through it on the show, and it is short enough to fit on one screen. Take a listen...and then send it to your own state rep. 🎧 Subscribe on (or on your preferred podcast platform)📣 Follow us on X \- 🎵 Follow us on TikTok \- 👍 Follow us on Facebook \- | QUICK HITS ⚡️MISSOURI : Last week we told you about West Virginia Freedom Caucus Chairman Chris Anders and his two-year fight to make the government get a warrant before tracking you with Flock cameras. This week a similar fight broke open in Missouri. A civilian employee of the St. Charles County Police Department got caught using the Flock system to track law-abiding people for personal reasons. Chief Kurt Frisz called the misuse "egregious," the employee was forced out, and the county bagged up all 28 cameras and cancelled Flock entirely. Now your Missouri Freedom Caucus , led by Senator Nick Schroer , is calling on every city and county in the state to do the same thing, and on the legislature to require a warrant when it convenes in 2027. ⚡️SOUTH CAROLINA : Earlier this week, your South Carolina Freedom Caucus called for Commerce Secretary Harry M. Lightsey III to resign. Not one person at Commerce has faced a consequence for letting cost overruns balloon to $150 million on the Scout Motor corporate welfare scheme that the legislature approved three years ago. If Lightsey has not quit by the time the House is recalled for budget veto overrides, the SC Freedom Caucus says it will introduce legislation to remove him. The Swamp needs to be held accountable. | WE NEED YOUR HELP TO KEEP THE MOMENTUM We are so proud and grateful for the State Freedom Caucuses in our Network. And we hope you are too.Elect fighters, then stand with them when the attacks come. If this is the kind of work you want more of, you can pitch in right here. We'll be back with another update soon. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresidentState Freedom Caucus Network | |

I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. **July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign.** While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. **Now here is the bad news.** **Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet._Fox News_. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race.** Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. **_I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious._** But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. **What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen.** Let us make August even stronger. clean_body: I have good news and bad news... | | | | | | | Peter, I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign. While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. Now here is the bad news. Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet.Fox News. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race. Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious. But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen. Let us make August even stronger. Thank you, Ken Paxton P.S. -- Fox News showed Talarico at 51%. Friend, I hate politics. I know that's counterintuitive to running for Congress. I hate the games, the spin, the way facts get twisted the moment they're inconvenient for someone's donors. I didn't grow up dreaming of being a politician, and honestly, I still don't think of myself as one. I'm a scientist. Someone trained to follow evidence, not talking points. I spent years in the lab asking hard questions and trusting the data, even when the answer wasn't the one I wanted. I brought that same instinct to the U.S. Senate, the National Institutes of Health, and the Government Accountability Office, where my job was to dig into how power and money actually move in Washington, and to call it out when something didn't add up. That's not politics. That's accountability. And it's exactly what's missing in Congress right now, where too many people have made a career out of protecting the status quo instead of fixing what's broken. clean_body: I'm not a politician. I'm a scientist | | = Friend, I hate politics. I know that's counterintuitive to running for Congress. I hate the games, the spin, the way facts get twisted the moment they're inconvenient for someone's donors. I didn't grow up dreaming of being a politician, and honestly, I still don't think of myself as one. I'm a scientist. Someone trained to follow evidence, not talking points. I spent years in the lab asking hard questions and trusting the data, even when the answer wasn't the one I wanted. I brought that same instinct to the U.S. Senate, the National Institutes of Health, and the Government Accountability Office, where my job was to dig into how power and money actually move in Washington, and to call it out when something didn't add up. That's not politics. That's accountability. And it's exactly what's missing in Congress right now, where too many people have made a career out of protecting the status quo instead of fixing what's broken. I'm running because TX-21 deserves someone who isn't playing the game, someone who's just trying to get the facts right and do right by the people who sent her there. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. I might hate politics, but I love our community, state, and country. And they are absolutely worth fighting for. Thanks for being in this fight with me. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Abbott has failed our public schools
body:
Under Abbott’s leadership, nearly 4 out of 10 public schools in Texas are falling behind.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Texas released its latest academic accountability ratings last week, and the verdict is in: _public school performance is falling flat._
**Of more than 9,000 campuses across the state, nearly 40% scored a C, D, or an F – 4 out of 10 Texas schools are failing or barely scraping by under Greg Abbott's watch.**
And even more troubling — the schools receiving failing grades at disproportionate rates are **predominantly low-income, Hispanic and Black communities.**
**The same communities** that are already underfunded and overlooked. The same communities that trigger state takeovers, with entire districts being stripped of local control while wealthier schools continue to receive higher ratings and more resources.
These ratings unjustly punish the schools that need the most help instead of providing them with the support they actually deserve. And yet, Abbott and his administration keep pushing forward as if nothing is wrong.
Our students and teachers deserve better. And our communities deserve a governor who will _actually_ invest in public education instead of letting schools fail.
**I'm running to change that — to fully fund our public schools, to support our teachers, and to make sure every child in Texas, regardless of their zip code, background, or socioeconomic status — has access to a quality education.**

name: Jamie Davis
subject: Why I was kicked out of Louisiana State University
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jamie Davis for U
body:
Baton Rouge was too big a city with too much temptation for the farm boy from the country town of Waterproof and my sophomore year I returned home with my tail between my legs
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qNWDKrIiO9EZXVbhKXPwKgPlVIkBrhkGnZ4WYwuD_fz3u0k5oqxNL4QXlY027QPoAmvPYnI5O0m3qWjltWXVFt7fx52ZFlXClWMfK90xwl0y6EcrXlDQAoVCxB5h736dzVjbZevCLJyRCA_HMKe1cXQZaazxgXHulnmX_xQHHz9KV-LL8eGn8qjXKazf3cVK0vdr-k2e3UxiGyA2cECGQYHYkB2DHABG&c=FCW4FdjfCHHJJuATtQNQSmAkEmB6aU6NeMGSVOFuVTNlA7iwG81qhg==&ch=PwZ8IdTcKg9Tz5CTj9HPQhc-sRvcXftplB7UtLPfq_jNxLHsmZfJoA==)
---
| Both of my parents were raised on farms in Tensas Parish, Louisiana. My father by a sharecropper and my mother on a plantation.
They picked cotton by hand. For them it was survival and my grandparents did not believe that a formal education was necessary. For them missing school to go to work on the farm was the norm.
The only time my Dad could go to school was when the weather was so bad that nothing could be done on the farm. Kids would tease him saying, "Must be raining cause Stump (his nickname) is here and not at the farm."
The highest level of education my dad reached was the 8th grade. His informal education taught him to run a successful farm and he became the first in our family to own land.

One of the last surviving photos of my father. Taken at my high school graduation in 1988. Pardon the graininess.
My Dad gave me the opportunity to chart a different course and I was the first person in my family to graduate from high school and I went on to attend Louisiana State University.
Ultimately, Baton Rouge was too big a city with too much temptation for the farm boy from the country town of Waterproof and I returned home with my tail between my legs, sent back on academic probation with my first child on the way.
My father asked me sarcastically, "What are you going to do now Mr. Man?" And I told him earnestly, "I'm going to farm just like you do."
And that's what I've been doing to this day. Starting off with the 220 acres that my Dad leased, we worked to grow the farm to where we stand today -- farming 3,200 acres, 700 of which belong to my family.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qNWDKrIiO9EZXVbhKXPwKgPlVIkBrhkGnZ4WYwuD_fz3u0k5oqxNL4QXlY027QPoAmvPYnI5O0m3qWjltWXVFt7fx52ZFlXClWMfK90xwl0y6EcrXlDQAoVCxB5h736dzVjbZevCLJyRCA_HMKe1cXQZaazxgXHulnmX_xQHHz9KV-LL8eGn8qjXKazf3cVK0vdr-k2e3UxiGyA2cECGQZaUS-6vz5AC&c=FCW4FdjfCHHJJuATtQNQSmAkEmB6aU6NeMGSVOFuVTNlA7iwG81qhg==&ch=PwZ8IdTcKg9Tz5CTj9HPQhc-sRvcXftplB7UtLPfq_jNxLHsmZfJoA==)
---
My son and I on the farm in 2021.
Unfortunately, in my 55 years of life here in Louisiana much has changed for the worse. Life has been sucked out of our small towns by monopolies like Dollar General and Walmart. Agriculture has become far less profitable, dominated by big business, and I have watched all of my Dad's friends that were black farmers go out of business.
I'm too old to learn a new trick. I've got 13 grandkids. I've watched my Dad break his body down through manual labor on this farm and saw my son lose part of his leg in a farming accident here. We've put too much of our blood into this soil. We can't just pick up this farm and move.
Our beloved home is turning into something unrecognizable. Louisianans on both sides of the aisle recognize this and they are ready for radical change.
I have to take a stand and fight for the way of life that we had when I grew up here as a boy and it's why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
Dems can win here statewide -- look no further than our last governor Democrat John Bel Edwards. And now a blue wave is forming, putting Louisiana in play for Democrats like me who can articulate an authentic vision of FDR style economic populism that can compete with and defeat the fake populism of MAGA.
Taking this seat means electing Louisiana's first black senator and statewide elected official since reconstruction. It means we reclaim the Senate with an unshakeable majority -- the Trump administration goes down in flames when we pull this off. I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. **July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign.** While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. **Now here is the bad news.** **Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet._Fox News_. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race.** Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. **_I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious._** But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. clean_body: July was historic. Then Fox News dropped this poll... I have good news and bad news... | | | | | | | Fellow Patriot, I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign. While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. Now here is the bad news. Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet.Fox News. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race. Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious. But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen. Let us make August even stronger. Thank you, Ken Paxton P.S. -- Fox News showed Talarico at 51%. body:
I want to make sure you know a little bit about me and my story.

| Hi, Peter,
It’s Congresswoman Jen Kiggans here. I want to make sure you know a little bit about me and my story.
I’m not a career politician—just a Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, and Mom who wants to make a difference in America. I grew tired of seeing the endless stream of false promises and fake agendas on TV...I think America deserves better—don’t you?
I served in the Navy for 10 years, and afterward, I went back to school to become a Nurse Practitioner. It has always been my mission to serve all Americans in the best way possible. Now, as an elected Congresswoman, I’m taking my mission to Capitol Hill.
But the far-Left doesn’t like me. They don’t care about making our nation’s future brighter for ALL Americans...they just care about their own WOKE agendas.
I won't EVER back down from a fight, and not one with so much at stake, but I don’t think I can win this alone.
As I said, I’m not a career politician, so asking for your support isn’t easy for me. But today, I’m humbly asking if you will chip in to support my fight against the far-Left.

Friend,

**I hate this part.**

I've told you about my career in public service, raising two young daughters with my wife, and running a small business near our home in North Carolina.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=5f15b0c7d9c8454f850f3f4d00f4ab00&_e=6W99gOSIEQeUDl0qILBzbjR1DIDCmMzkjDBoHqAH0lcm5mmwuRc-omDMQmhr5qefyhoyVtbLvlPFl0ON8xp_sO5QOExCY8fRU4cUYSwZbroFMflq9gTdpxdp7sjv1zxPjG3nkR_R6qfB7Zp8baGQJ8Vg-Tf34An4X7zNLNnz7_InhiCv2KQ3ddJMj7Wr2lHNufjS1p9Bom9xbK_CDdPkDdhOK1tTZED-1LLLOsCcJu9BrHC7GrRxc1oQy3Hp4RBQgCyB8mDSIIm7dsUZPOlju3nbBWrOH_cxuuWZEZzCL6CDNM5T1QNzk9X2ALyGlkhGnx3sC3foIqNxSW3wM_fkY-kxcUs3LUuA_Ic4caI2KYz0fNIFHZOR-5rdQ0Gx_JF_v54LGqOfyoHoj6OgZsr3cJQivajnaGFIysjNCks9MXEi5j9E5Vh-LG7pcqs1hXnbNH51xHoaMMjWwxYfFBx8xYn2KrzylrGu9v5qfriILPgS4USTlWFfVl2VG22Rogen5wWu9Sdb163q1OvIr0NcHaO0NUuzQuQKuFF0YeYBEIY%3D)
I could talk to you all day about faith, family, and freedom, and even firearms, but I HATE talking to you about finances.

**There, I said it -_campaign finances_ , to be exact. **

Running for Congress to serve you, protect families like mine, and make our nation great again is truly such an honor. After serving in Afghanistan I could tell you a million times over how precious our freedom is, but the hard truth is that without a solid foundation of campaign finances, authentic candidates who want to Save America get nowhere.

Our campaign, and I can't tell you how much I HATE to say this, **we are about to miss our End-of-Month deadline.** Deep-pocketed liberals are working hard to target every single conservative candidate in the country and we NEED to push back. We can't afford to lose a single seat. **So I 'm coming to you with one honest ask.**

**[I need your help. clean_body: every dollar donated helps. | Friend, I hate this part. I've told you about my career in public service, raising two young daughters with my wife, and running a small business near our home in North Carolina. I could talk to you all day about faith, family, and freedom, and even firearms, but I HATE talking to you about finances. There, I said it -campaign finances , to be exact. Running for Congress to serve you, protect families like mine, and make our nation great again is truly such an honor. After serving in Afghanistan I could tell you a million times over how precious our freedom is, but the hard truth is that without a solid foundation of campaign finances, authentic candidates who want to Save America get nowhere. Our campaign, and I can't tell you how much I HATE to say this, we are about to miss our End-of-Month deadline. Deep-pocketed liberals are working hard to target every single conservative candidate in the country and we NEED to push back. We can't afford to lose a single seat. So I 'm coming to you with one honest ask. It really would make a huge difference to the future of this campaign. This is our one shot to make up lost ground and hit our goal. subject: When the storms came, my trust was in something far greater than politics.

body:
I kept the faith, and together, we proved them all wrong.
| | | | [](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

Friend,
Since the day I returned to the White House, I have felt the mighty hand of God guiding this movement. His Word reminds us: “If God is for us, who can be against us?”
The enemies of freedom thought they could break us with lies, with weaponized courts, with endless persecution, but they were WRONG.
Our strength does not come from Washington insiders. It comes from the LORD. Always has. Always will.
**[Let me tell you this: the fight to restore America’s foundation of FAITH, FAMILY, and FREEDOM is just beginning.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
The early Patriots faced impossible odds, but they stood together with unyielding courage. We must do the exact same. United by prayer. United by conviction. United under God.
**So here’s the deal. I need you with me right NOW.**
**[Please, if you can afford it, step up today and show the Radical Left that we will NEVER surrender. Together, guided by faith, we’ll RESTORE the values that made America GREAT.>>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
**_[]()_** And remember this: when you stand with this movement, you are doing far more than joining a political effort. You are sowing a SEED OF FAITH into the future of our Nation.
The Bible tells us that faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains. Together, our faith will move America back to GOD. Back to TRUTH. Back to GREATNESS.
[MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
**_[]()_** If you cannot give right now, I want you to know this: your PRAYERS, your FAITH, and your unwavering SUPPORT mean more to me than all the money in the world.
With God as our refuge, and with YOU standing shoulder to shoulder by my side, **WE WILL SAVE AMERICA.**
Thank you, and may God bless you,
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
**_[]()_** Donald John Trump

On "Truth" Social, Trump announced that the U.S. Census Bureau, the agency responsible for the decennial census used for congressional apportionment, was tasked with checking voter records against citizenship records from the 2020 election--a mission far outside the intended scope of the agency.
Trump claimed that the Census Bureau has already proved that he actually won the 2020 election, claiming that the Bureau has found over 24,000 Noncitizens who voted illegally in the 2020 election.

Weeks ago, when Trump gave his primetime national address on elections, Trump made a dubious claim that the Department of Homeland Security found more than 250,000 noncitizens registered to vote in just four states.
But nobody from the Trump administration can explain where those numbers came from. NPR reported that multiple state officials warned these completely made-up numbers could be used by the Trump administration to justify federal law enforcement interference in counting votes this November.

name: Scott Wiener
subject: We Must Ban Conversion Therapy in California
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
| |

Peter,

**Something big happened this week: the California Legislature passed my bill to strengthen our state's ban on conversion therapy.**

This is a landmark victory for LGBTQ young people - and it could not come at a more urgent moment.

Earlier this year, the Supreme Court cast legal doubt on state conversion therapy bans, putting protections here in California at risk.

We refused to wait for those protections to be stripped away. We acted - and now my bill is headed to the Governor's desk.

_Conversion therapy is psychological torture._ It is dangerous, ineffective, and condemned by every major medical association. LGBTQ young people deserve support and affirmation - not shame, trauma, or attempts to erase who they are.

name: Ken Burns
subject: Join me in supporting Roy
body:
Winning this race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1164&source=&t=1&akid=2874%2E124072%2Ep3ixhW)

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1164&amount=5&t=8&akid=2874%2E124072%2Ep3ixhW)
Hi, Peter – it’s Ken Burns.
Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to Roy Cooper’s campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. Winning this race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate, so I hope you’ll join me in supporting Roy. [**_Will you chip in $5?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1164&amount=5&t=9&akid=2874%2E124072%2Ep3ixhW)
Across this country, people are hurting in ways that don’t always make the history books but shape lives all the same.
The grocery bills that are too high. A lifesaving prescription that forces a difficult choice. A paycheck that just doesn’t stretch as far as it once did. | These are the real pressures that define a moment.
**Roy Cooper has spent much of his life as a public servant working to ease those burdens.**
Not seeking attention but doing the work. Expanding access to affordable health care. Investing in public schools. Defending the idea that government, at its best, is not distant – but present, steady and accountable to the people it serves.
It is the kind of leadership that rarely makes noise, but over time, it leaves a mark.
Right now, there are those who want to take North Carolina – and our country – in a different direction. They see division as a strategy; they mistake power for purpose. They are organized. They are well-funded by dark-money and special interest groups.
**The only way we can defeat them is if dedicated, caring people like you choose not to sit back but to take part. The power rests in our hands, and we must use it.**
[**_Will you make a donation of $5 or any amount today to help Roy flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1164&amount=5&t=10&akid=2874%2E124072%2Ep3ixhW)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1164&amount=5&t=11&akid=2874%2E124072%2Ep3ixhW)

Thank you for doing your part,

Ken Burns

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

body:
The Navy (almost certainly at Hegseth and Trump’s direction) is considering renaming the carrier USS Doris Miller after Donald Trump.
#
Making sure you saw this.
The Navy (almost certainly at Hegseth and Trump’s direction) is considering renaming the carrier USS Doris Miller after Donald Trump. Miller is one of the first heroes of WWII, and we’re _sure_ it’s just a coincidence that this would be the first carrier named for a Black enlisted sailor.
The USS Doris Miller is one of several new Ford class aircraft carriers, this one scheduled for delivery by 2032. It’s important to note the word scheduled, because Trump has pushed for ridiculous and substantial design changes on the carriers because he doesn’t like the way they look. And just to name it, this is coming after he and Hegseth said that the sailors aboard the USS Lincoln were lying about the conditions onboard after being deployed for more than 260 days.
So, not only is he calling sailors in harm’s way liars, not only is he driving up development time and costs by years and billions of dollars, he’s elevating himself above a fallen American hero by replacing Doris Miller’s name with his own.
If you’re infuriated by this, you’re not alone. Yesterday, thousands of people signed our petition to stop Trump from renaming the USS Doris Miller for himself. Today, we’re asking you to join them.
[**Add your name and help us make sure Trump’s name never gets painted on the hull of that aircraft carrier.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260823-1-360&refcode2=35498.3013755.KesKo9&akid=35498%2E3013755%2EKesKo9)
| [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260823-1-360&refcode2=35498.3013755.KesKo9&akid=35498%2E3013755%2EKesKo9)
---
Thank you. Our original email with additional information on Doris Miller is below:
* * *
Peter:
On December 7th, 1941, a mess attendant named Doris Miller was serving aboard the battleship West Virginia in Pearl Harbor. His job was one of just a few available to Black sailors in the segregated military. He served breakfast to the other sailors that morning, when around 0800 the West Virginia was struck by the first of seven torpedoes.
Miller reported to battlestations. The ship’s Captain, Mervyn Bennion, was wounded in the first attack, and Miller helped carry him to shelter. Because of the color of his skin, Miller was never given a chance to train on any of the ship’s weapons. Two of his shipmates trained him to operate anti-aircraft weapons on the fly, and he started firing. He fired until he ran out of ammunition, and was credited with shooting down two enemy aircraft.
The ship, struck repeatedly by armor piercing bombs and torpedoes, was leaking oil. Fire spread, smoke engulfing the conning tower. Miller then helped carry Captain Bennion out of the smoke, up to the navigation bridge. He went on to move more injured sailors out of the oil and water to the deck.
In 1942, bills were introduced in the House and Senate to award Miller the Medal of Honor, but the Secretary of the Navy recommended against it. Miller ultimately received the Navy Cross, and went back into active service in the Pacific. In 1943 he was aboard the carrier Liscome Bay when it was struck by a torpedo. The ship went down in less than a half hour, and Miller’s body was never found.
Doris Miller is a hero to all Americans... but not to Pete Hegseth and Donald Trump.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260823-1-360&refcode2=35498.3013755.KesKo9&akid=35498%2E3013755%2EKesKo9)
Yeah, that’s complete bullshit. We’re not going to let it happen.
[**Peter, add your name _immediately_ and demand that the carrier CVN-81, the USS Doris Miller, NEVER be named after a draft-dodger who insults Veterans, the fallen, and their families. A disgrace who directed an attack on the US Capitol, started an illegal war, and got Americans killed. A coward who has trampled the graves of the fallen at Arlington, and wants to put them in his shadow by building a 250 foot tall arch, dedicated entirely to himself.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260823-1-360&refcode2=35498.3013755.KesKo9&akid=35498%2E3013755%2EKesKo9)

Thank you,
The team at VoteVets

Marx knew that people anchored in faith are people who can't be fully controlled.[Here's what the Radical Left doesn't want you to notice:](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.) they never got rid of religion, they just replaced it. | | _With just sixteen days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 16, I am highlighting my plans to ensure everyone has access to affordable, high-quality childcare._
* * *
Dear David, When we talk about the foundations of a strong economy, we often point to roads, good schools, and housing. But there’s another form of infrastructure just as critical, one that supports every industry in New Hampshire: **childcare.** Without affordable, reliable childcare, parents can’t work, businesses can’t hire, and children lose out on the early learning experiences that set them up for success. **[Childcare is a basic necessity, and I’m determined to ensure that everyone has access to affordable, high-quality childcare. If you agree, please pitch in to support this fight:](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9PiAmeJLe9U_CD5kRNywvg~~/AAUS1hA~/wzGZsJC4IG6zVKwuf6jnqzxjdfyEYULiBD-RUt0jw_YiiHKL4a63ZAC1P2ebi5xcN2Kr469HYEsGdAaPNRJptysdTTUXECeFDSu_oYZS-Ry-_CXO_XCq7OsB2Ngv7ZqtTBR-Latgh8o-vi_gQUp-zmPdMSpBJ8sjTO0OaMfrW2RXqd-FNYpN7B14g3BBztecHf_hRfLoF7OskrP0L16YA5O4K01xnnTvzZ3Hb4M8SCtNlOZEDMyT4sCnmcYwyu53Pr4T9RkcyvDoSHXVYGeahA~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9PiAmeJLe9U_CD5kRNywvg~~/AAUS1hA~/wzGZsJC4IG6zVKwuf6jnqzxjdfyEYULiBD-RUt0jw_YiiHKL4a63ZAC1P2ebi5xcN2Kr469HYEsGdAaPNRJptysdTTUXECeFDSu_oYZS-Ry-_CXO_XCq7OsB2Ngv7ZqtTBR-Latgh8o-vi_gQUp-zmPdMSpBJ8sjTO0OaMfrW2RXqd-FNYpN7B14g3BBztecHf_hRfLoF7OskrP0L16YA5O4K01xnnTvzZ3Hb4M8SCtNlOZEDMyT4sCnmcYwyu53Pr4T9RkcyvDoSHXVYGeahA~~)
---
Despite the urgent need for affordable childcare, New Hampshire faces a severe shortage. Between 2017 and 2024, the state lost nearly **_13 percent_** of its licensed childcare capacity for children under five.
Last year, I toured a childcare facility in Rochester with its Executive Director, Cora-Lynn Hoppe, and Family Service Coordinator, Anne Grassie. This center, like many others in our district, was a shining light of warmth and joy.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9PiAmeJLe9U_CD5kRNywvg~~/AAUS1hA~/wzGZsJC4IG6zVKwuf6jnqzxjdfyEYULiBD-RUt0jw_YiiHKL4a63ZAC1P2ebi5xcN2Kr469HYEsGdAaPNRJptysdTTUXECeFDSu_oYZS-Ry-_CXO_XCq7OsB2Ngv7ZqtTBR-Latgh8o-vi_gQUp-zmPdMSpBJ8sjTO0OaMfrW2RXqd-FNYpN7B14g3BBztecHf_hRfLoF7OskrP0L16YA5O4K01xnnTvzZ3Hb4M8SCtNlOZEDMyT4sCnmcYwyu53Pr4T9RkcyvDoSHXVYGeahA~~)
But too many New Hampshire families can’t afford what it takes to send their children to facilities like the one in Rochester. The average cost of sending two children to daycare in New Hampshire is **_$32,000 a year_**. That’s about a third of the median household income in our state.
**That’s real money, David, real money that many families can’t afford to spend on childcare alone.**
So here’s my solution: **We need to cap childcare costs at 7% of a family’s income.** We also need to ensure every childcare worker earns a living wage so facilities can recruit workers, retain staff, keep classrooms open, and give families the options they need to give their children a strong start.
**[I would be one of the few working moms in Congress. I know firsthand how hard it is to find and afford childcare, so I’m going to make this issue central to my legislative agenda. If you’re ready to join me, please donate to my campaign today so we can win this race and take the fight for our children’s future to Congress.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9PiAmeJLe9U_CD5kRNywvg~~/AAUS1hA~/wzGZsJC4IG6zVKwuf6jnqzxjdfyEYULiBD-RUt0jw_YiiHKL4a63ZAC1P2ebi5xcN2Kr469HYEsGdAaPNRJptysdTTUXECeFDSu_oYZS-Ry-_CXO_XCq7OsB2Ngv7ZqtTBR-Latgh8o-vi_gQUp-zmPdMSpBJ8sjTO0OaMfrW2RXqd-FNYpN7B14g3BBztecHf_hRfLoF7OskrP0L16YA5O4K01xnnTvzZ3Hb4M8SCtNlOZEDMyT4sCnmcYwyu53Pr4T9RkcyvDoSHXVYGeahA~~)**

clean_body: An issue a day | | | | With just sixteen days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 16, I am highlighting my plans to ensure everyone has access to affordable, high-quality childcare. Dear David, When we talk about the foundations of a strong economy, we often point to roads, good schools, and housing. But there’s another form of infrastructure just as critical, one that supports every industry in New Hampshire: childcare. Without affordable, reliable childcare, parents can’t work, businesses can’t hire, and children lose out on the early learning experiences that set them up for success. ~~ | | ~~ Despite the urgent need for affordable childcare, New Hampshire faces a severe shortage. Between 2017 and 2024, the state lost nearly 13 percent of its licensed childcare capacity for children under five. Last year, I toured a childcare facility in Rochester with its Executive Director, Cora-Lynn Hoppe, and Family Service Coordinator, Anne Grassie. This center, like many others in our district, was a shining light of warmth and joy. ~~ But too many New Hampshire families can’t afford what it takes to send their children to facilities like the one in Rochester. The average cost of sending two children to daycare in New Hampshire is $32,000 a year. That’s about a third of the median household income in our state. That’s real money, David, real money that many families can’t afford to spend on childcare alone. So here’s my solution: We need to cap childcare costs at 7% of a family’s income. We also need to ensure every childcare worker earns a living wage so facilities can recruit workers, retain staff, keep classrooms open, and give families the options they need to give their children a strong start. ~~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | ~ ~ | ~ | ~~ This country has the resources to treat its kids and the wonderful adults who care for them better than this. Friend,
This race is heating up fast, but I wanted to pause for a moment to say **thank you**. This campaign would not be possible if it weren't for your incredible support.
Every day, people like you step up to power this movement.
You make it possible for me to become the first female Native American Governor in U.S. history. You make it possible for me to fight to protect our sacred land and make sure New Mexicans have access to the quality healthcare they deserve. Your support means I can fight for lower prices at the grocery store and the pump._**It’s all because of you, friend.**_
Our movement is rooted in the power of community, and I couldn't be more proud to fight for all New Mexicans with you by my side. Thank you so much for your continued support of my campaign. With this team behind me, we can achieve anything.
Be fierce,
Deb 💚
_[**P.S. If you are in a position to help us get a head start on our end-of-month fundraising goal, please consider chipping in today. Here’s what’s next.
#

Peter,
On Friday, I sent you a message about the next steps for our campaign. We ended our race with a good amount of money in the bank — thanks to supporters like you who believe Democrats need to go on the offense and invest in tough states.
Even though I won’t be on the ballot in November, we’re not letting that money go to waste. In these final 75 days before the election, we are making the most strategic investments for candidates and organizations who will help us accomplish our ultimate mission: To hold Trump accountable and defend our democracy.
We made our first donation of $400,000 to the Florida Democratic Party. Hundreds of you also joined in with a donation of your own. That is GREATLY appreciated and will help our party build the infrastructure we need to win in November and beyond.
**Today, we’re helping Josh Turek and Mary Peltola.**
We are donating $15,000 to Josh and Mary’s Senate campaigns. $7,500 each to help win back Iowa and Alaska’s Senate seats this year.
Here’s why:
Democrats have a VERY tough Senate map this year, and the only real path to taking back the majority is by flipping some states that Trump won in the last election.
Josh Turek in Iowa and Mary Peltola in Alaska are running incredible races. Cook Political Report ranks both of these Senate seats as toss-ups — the most competitive that an election can be. But that also means they have a huge target on their backs.
Senate Republicans’ Super PAC have already spent tens of millions of dollars to pummel them in attack ads. That’s not even counting the money that Trump’s Super PAC, Trump himself, or even Elon Musk could throw in as polls tighten.
So Josh and Mary could really use all of our help. Quickly.

Hi Peter,We’re officially in the sprint to the general election on November 3rd.

I want to take a moment to say _thank you_ – for showing up, for chipping in, for knocking doors, and for every conversation you've had with a friend or neighbor about what's at stake this year. Your support has meant so much, and I’m grateful to know you’re by my side in the fight ahead.

Now, we focus on the hard work of the next 72 days. This is one of the most consequential fights of our lifetimes, and what we do right now will determine whether we deliver a blue wave and the direction of our country for years to come.

I want to take a moment to remember what we're fighting for, because this administration is counting on us to lose sight of it.

A safer, more affordable, and more just America. Access to quality healthcare. An economy that works for all of us – not just the rich and powerful. An immigration system grounded in safety, dignity, and justice. Leaders who put people over profits.

If we win in November, we can protect women's bodily autonomy and their right to access safe, science-backed reproductive care. We can push back on RFK Jr.'s dangerous misinformation and defend evidence-based public health. We can address Trump's affordability crisis and deliver real relief for working families. We can defend our democracy and the constitutional checks and balances this administration has spent the 18 months trying to dismantle.

_We can do it all if we put in the work right now._

**I'm going to spend every one of these 72 days doing what I've always done: knocking doors, listening to constituents, and fighting back. The road to the House majority requires that we hold MN-03, so let’s make sure we do!**

Friends,
Fellow Republicans and I, under President Trump's leadership, have secured the border, protected our Second Amendment rights, reduced regulations, blocked the largest tax increase on the middle class in history, driven crime down (the murder rate is at a 125-year low), invested $50 billion to help rural hospitals, reduced fentanyl overdoses, and strengthened our military.
Right here in the 5th District, we have helped facilitate $20 billion in economic development investments, returned nearly $10 million to hardworking people owed by the federal government, assisted 57 Charlottesville constituents in safely returning home from the Middle East during rocket attacks, and much more.
In contrast, my opponent Tom Perriello, a one-term congressman who has historically flip-flopped on issues like life and the Second Amendment to win votes, is a radical leftist who wants to grow government and tax-and-spend you out of existence. Thanks to Perriello, health care is unaffordable. He cast the deciding vote for Obamacare (the Unaffordable Care Act) that has driven up health care costs across America every year since. He is a radical climate-change advocate who proudly touts his cap-and-trade vote to impose a crushing carbon-credit system on businesses. He worked for George Soros and, as a leader at the Soros Open Society Foundations, advanced policies that critics say use mass immigration, a classic communist technique, to destabilize countries. This is why countries like Finland and others have had to shut down their borders.
This midterm is common sense versus crazy communism.
I am humbly asking for your vote for re-election as your congressman to represent Virginia's 5th district. Please remind your friends: early voting begins in 26 days on September 18. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.
To help, volunteer, donate, or get involved, contact my Political Director, Ramona Christian, at [ramona@mcguireva.com](mailto:ramona@mcguireva.com) or 434-391-4546.
Monday, August 24, is my birthday. I will preside over the floor at 9 a.m. as Speaker Pro Tempore at the US Capitol, then head to the Pentagon to celebrate a win we've worked on for over a year for the 5th District. | Tracy and I had a fantastic time at the first-ever Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, D.C. this weekend. It was the inaugural NTT IndyCar Series race on the streets around the National Mall, run on a 1.7-mile, 7-turn temporary circuit that took drivers past the U.S. Capitol, the Washington Monument, the Smithsonian museums, and other iconic landmarks as part of America's 250th anniversary celebrations.
Before the race, all branches of our military marched by, and the flyovers from each branch truly echoed the sound of freedom. American driver Kyle Kirkwood dominated from start to finish, leading 128 of the 147 laps on his way to a decisive victory. We live in the greatest country on earth. I am proud to be an American!

clean_body: | | | | == Vote Ramona Christian for CD 5 GOP Chair | The 5th District GOP Chair Convention will be held on Saturday, November 14. Our district will be far more successful with Ramona Christian as Chair. Please ask friends who live in the 5th District to download, fill out, and turn in this form so they will be eligible to vote at the convention. [[Click here to download and print the form]](==) Friends, Fellow Republicans and I, under President Trump's leadership, have secured the border, protected our Second Amendment rights, reduced regulations, blocked the largest tax increase on the middle class in history, driven crime down (the murder rate is at a 125-year low), invested $50 billion to help rural hospitals, reduced fentanyl overdoses, and strengthened our military. Right here in the 5th District, we have helped facilitate $20 billion in economic development investments, returned nearly $10 million to hardworking people owed by the federal government, assisted 57 Charlottesville constituents in safely returning home from the Middle East during rocket attacks, and much more. In contrast, my opponent Tom Perriello, a one-term congressman who has historically flip-flopped on issues like life and the Second Amendment to win votes, is a radical leftist who wants to grow government and tax-and-spend you out of existence. Thanks to Perriello, health care is unaffordable. He cast the deciding vote for Obamacare (the Unaffordable Care Act) that has driven up health care costs across America every year since. He is a radical climate-change advocate who proudly touts his cap-and-trade vote to impose a crushing carbon-credit system on businesses. He worked for George Soros and, as a leader at the Soros Open Society Foundations, advanced policies that critics say use mass immigration, a classic communist technique, to destabilize countries. This is why countries like Finland and others have had to shut down their borders. This midterm is common sense versus crazy communism. I am humbly asking for your vote for re-election as your congressman to represent Virginia's 5th district. Please remind your friends: early voting begins in 26 days on September 18. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3. To help, volunteer, donate, or get involved, contact my Political Director, Ramona Christian, at mailto:ramona@mcguireva.com or 434-391-4546. Monday, August 24, is my birthday. I will preside over the floor at 9 a.m. as Speaker Pro Tempore at the US Capitol, then head to the Pentagon to celebrate a win we've worked on for over a year for the 5th District. More on that later. Please donate here. Here's some of what we've been up to and what's on my mind: == Here's some of what we've been up to and what's on my mind: | Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, D.C. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Secretary Doug Burgum | U.S. Department of the Interior | Tracy and I had a fantastic time at the first-ever Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, D.C. this weekend. It was the inaugural NTT IndyCar Series race on the streets around the National Mall, run on a 1.7-mile, 7-turn temporary circuit that took drivers past the U.S. Capitol, the Washington Monument, the Smithsonian museums, and other iconic landmarks as part of America's 250th anniversary celebrations. Before the race, all branches of our military marched by, and the flyovers from each branch truly echoed the sound of freedom. American driver Kyle Kirkwood dominated from start to finish, leading 128 of the 147 laps on his way to a decisive victory. We live in the greatest country on earth. I am proud to be an American! | Campaigning Around The District | Freedom 250 Bluegrass & BBQ | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | We had so much fun at the Freedom 250 Bluegrass & BBQ sponsored by the Prince Edward GOP Committee. Thank you, Prince, Edward GOP Committee chair, Carolyn Bowman and team for an incredible night. Thank you to all the GOP Committee chairs there, our speakers, and everyone else for making this such a wonderful event. Thank you Delegate Tommy Wright for your endorsement. It was a positive experience with a lot of promotion for teamwork. Folkes, this is the way the GOP committee should organize events and this is a solid example for other county cities and towns in Virginia. If you want to win in the battle to save our country, we need to be about addition and multiplication. This keep it small control at all is what causes us to lose in Virginia. Well, I ask you to put God first, put your differences aside treat people respect and work as a team. If we do that, not me, but we will not just save Virginia, we will save America. God bless you, and God bless the USA! | Virginia International Raceway (VIR) WIMNA | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | For the four-wheel sports car enthusiasts out there, this weekend is an another great reminder that Virginia's 5th District has something for everyone. I've spent time at VIRginia International Raceway right here in our district taking in some of the best GT road racing in the country during the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship's Michelin GT Challenge at VIR (plus the Virginia Is for Racing Lovers Grand Prix and supporting races). It's been fantastic learning more about the real economic impact VIR has on our community, supporting local jobs, vendors, partners, veterans' programs, training facilities, and more. Please tell a friend, we've got 26 days until early voting begins on September 18. Election Day is November 3. Tickets and more info at == | | | | | | | | | Danville, Virginia | | | Fluvanna GOP | | | Thank you to == GOP Chair Barbara Haines and Committee for representing the Republican team at the Fluvanna Fair. I had a lot of fun at the fair. Together, we will win in November! Reminder: Early voting begins in 26 days on September 18. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd. | Crescent Inn Restaurant | | | Reminder: We have 26 days until early voting begins September 18. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd. | Powhatan County | | | In Powhatan County, waving and thanking hard-working Americans for our huge primary win on their way to work. | Virginia International Raceway (VIR) Moto America | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | For the two-wheel motorcycle enthusiasts out there, Sunday was a great reminder that Virginia's 5th District has something for everyone. I spent a couple of hours at == right here in our district and got to take in some of the best road racing in the country. I had a blast learning about their concerns and the real economic impact VIR has on our community. I even got a hat signed by several racers for motorcycle enthusiast, a friend and fellow veteran who is on hospice and battling cancer. Praying for George. The == == Quad Lock Superbike series delivered exciting races: Great racing, great venue, and another reason to be proud of what we have right here in VA-05. | RIP Deputy Burlie Winfoot Duvall III | | | | | | | | | | | Our community is heartbroken by the tragic loss of Appomattox County Sheriff's Deputy Burlie Winfoot Duvall III. He gave his life while on duty, helping at a crash scene and protecting the people of Appomattox County. I attended the memorial service at Thomas Road Baptist Church, joined by hundreds of law enforcement officers and many others. Appomattox County Sheriff's Office Chaplain Jonathan A. Watson, Sheriff Robby Richardson, and others led a moving service that celebrated his life and his quiet dedication to serving others. His example of goodwill and selflessness inspires and challenges all of us to be better. My thoughts and prayers are with his wife Jennifer, their children BJ, Zane, and Adi, his parents, and the entire Appomattox County Sheriff's Office family. == | Early Morning Bush Hogging | | My wife Tracy was very happy I was able to squeeze in some early morning time on the tractor to do a little bush hogging before hitting the campaign trail. | | | | | Started at 6 a.m. in Charlottesville waving good morning and thanking folks for our huge primary win on their way to work. | Breakfast in Charlottesville | | | | | | | Enjoyed meeting people over breakfast in Charlottesville, Virginia. to discuss what matters most to them. | Fluvanna Fair | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Stopped by the Fluvanna County Fair and got to walk around, shake hands, and meet a bunch of folks and thanked them for the strong 78% win in Fluvanna County in the Republican primary. By the grace of God, we were able to unite Republicans and win 300 out of 303 precincts. | 2A Wins | | | | | Amelia County Fair | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Stopped by the Amelia County Fair and got to walk around, shake hands, and meet a bunch of folks and thanked them for the huge 83% win in Amelia County in the Republican primary. | Around The District | | | | | | | | | | | In Charlottesville, I visited the largest independently owned Pepsi bottling company in the world established in 1908, and the only one left in Virginia. I also spoke with leaders from the hospitality industry at Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, and toured UVA's Innovations in Fabrication Facility, where researchers have several major quantum related breakthroughs and focus on Micro-systems: infrared, terahertz, and photonics devices, Micro-fluidics: solar cells and functional materials, Bio-manufacturing: nano-biology and soft materials, and Semiconductors: nano-scale device fabrication. I stopped by Mincer's, the University of Virginia's imprinted sportswear shop to purchase some UVA merch, visited the Albemarle County government building to say hello and share ideas from constituents, and stopped by to visit friends at First Free Coffee and Chick-fil-A. We finished up the day in Charlottesville with a fundraising event. A Day In Charlottesville | | Scored my UVA tie Mincer's in time for football season. Proud that the University of Virginia, founded by great Founding Father Thomas Jefferson, sits right here in Virginia's 5th Congressional District. == is home to world-class science, Virginia's first NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, strong engineering programs, and so much more. Hope to see you around Grounds or out across the Fifth. Go Hoos! Wahoowa! | A Day In Danville | | | | | | | | | Meeting with folks and listening to their concerns all across the district. In Danville, we visited Averett University Aviation to discuss the funding we're helping secure to strengthen their aviation program. We met with leaders at SOVAH Hospital about healthcare challenges and the largest investment in rural healthcare in history. At Megapetera Cybersecurity, we talked about new NDAA language that will help them acquire critical qualifications. We also stopped by Boone Tractor to say hello and thank the team for everything they do. We joined school board members, city council members, ==, Delegate Madison Whittle, and Chamber of Commerce leaders at the Danville Chamber of Commerce Legislative Update. This week I was also featured on the cover of the Danville Register & Bee in two stories: one covering U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. joining me in Danville to discuss transforming rural health, and another titled "It's official: McGuire vs. Perriello for 5th District." That piece highlighted my landslide win in the Republican primary, where by the grace of God and a lot of teamwork, I carried every county, including Danville with 93% and Pittsylvania with 92%. | Virginia Republican Nominees | | Please join me in congratulating our Republican nominees for U.S. Congress and U.S. Senate: District 1 - Rob Wittman District 2 - Jen Kiggans District 3 - Edwin Rivera District 4 - Robert Murray District 5 - John McGuire District 6 - Ben Cline District 7 - Doug Ollivant District 8 - Tony Sabio District 9 - Morgan Griffith District 10 - Dave Beckwith District 11 - Arthur Purves U.S. Senate - Bert Mizusawa It's common sense versus crazy communism. Please ask your family members and friends to vote Republican. Mark your calendar: Early voting begins September 18th Election Day is November 3rd Every vote matters. Visit their websites, share this post, and remind your friends and family to VOTE! == == == == == | Empowering America's Parents | | == | Former Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin has launched Empowering America's Parents, a national group focused on expanding school choice through the Education Freedom Tax Credit. Our children should be taught how to think, not what to think and parents should sit at the head of the table in their children's education. [[Click here to learn more, sign up, and get involved]](==) | We Must Defeat The George Soros Backed Democrat Tom Perriello In November | == | Democrat Tom Perriello took hundreds of thousands of dollars from George Soros and his family and he served as Executive Director at George Soros' Open Society Foundations from 2018 to 2023. That organization has long funded groups advocating for open borders and more open immigration policies, along with illegal immigrant rights and reduced Immigration law enforcement. As a Congressman, Perriello cast the key vote for the "Unaffordable Care Act" (Obamacare) in 2010. This terrible vote caused insurance costs to go up every year since and gave Insurance companies a huge pay raise. As a Congressman, Perriello said he was pro life, and then he ran for governor and said he was not pro life. As a Congressman, Perriello said he was pro gun, and then he ran for governor and he said the NRA is a "nut-job extremist organization." | Vote Ramona Christian For The Next VA-05 Committee Chair | | Please sign up and vote at the convention November 14th for my friend and Political Director Ramona Christian to be the next Virginia Fifth Congressional District Chair. We would not have had such an overwhelming huge 85% win without her leadership and ability to bring people together a team. That's exactly what the Virginia Fifth District needs. The convention will be Saturday, November 14th. Our district would be far more successful with Ramona Christian.
